text_en: Niigata Station. This major terminal reigning over the Sea of Japan side is the sacred sanctuary where the journey through Echigo begins. From the modern elevated platforms, memories of steam locomotive smoke crossing the Shinano River may be fading, but the port town's energy overwhelms every traveler passing through the gates.
product_ja:
加島屋 さけ茶漬
新潟の食卓、そして全国のご飯愛好家が憧れる「加島屋」のさけ茶漬。脂の乗ったキングサーモンを丁寧にほぐし、伝統の調味料で熟成させたその味わいは、まさに至高の極みです。スプーン一杯でご飯が何杯でも進む濃厚な旨味は、他の追随を許しません。自分へのご褒美に、大切な方への贈り物に、絶対に外さない新潟の顔です。
product_en:
Kashimaya Salmon Chazuke
Kashimaya's salmon chazuke is a favorite of Niigata dining tables and rice lovers from all over the country. The taste of fatty king salmon that is carefully flaked and aged with traditional seasonings is truly the ultimate. The rich flavor that goes with every spoonful of rice is unrivaled. This Niigata face is a must-have as a treat for yourself or as a gift for a loved one.
product_fr:
Chazuke au saumon Kashimaya
Le chazuke au saumon de Kashimaya est un favori des tables à manger de Niigata et des amateurs de riz de tout le pays. Le goût du saumon royal gras, soigneusement émietté et vieilli avec des assaisonnements traditionnels, est vraiment le nec plus ultra. La riche saveur qui accompagne chaque cuillerée de riz est inégalée. Ce visage Niigata est un incontournable pour se faire plaisir ou comme cadeau pour un proche.
product_tw:
鹿島屋鮭魚茶泡飯
鹿島屋的鮭魚茶泡飯是新潟餐桌和全國各地米飯愛好者的最愛。經過精心切片並用傳統調味料陳釀的肥大王鮭魚的味道確實是極致。每一匙米飯的濃鬱味道是無與倫比的。這款 Niigata 面孔是您必備的禮物，無論是犒賞自己還是送給心愛之人的禮物。

text_en: Hakusan Station. Crossing the Shinano River bridge into the city's bustle, this station is a junction where academia and faith intersect. The roof tiles of Furumachi seen from the window convey the lively history of the canals once bustling with boats.

Hakusan Shrine. As the guardian of Niigata for a thousand years, this sacred sanctuary is the spiritual cornerstone of Echigo. The sound of clapping at the vermillion shrine purifies the city's noise, bringing tranquility to the traveler's heart.

Sekiya Station. Once a thriving railway hub where freight lines branched off, the pride of the heavy rails still lingers here. Heading toward the sea from here, one feels the tenacity of predecessors who protected Niigata from flood disasters.

Sekiya Diversion Channel. This massive artificial river that diverts the Shinano River's fury to the Sea of Japan is a modern bulwark of engineering. The majesty of the giant sluice gates tells the story of Niigata's resolve to live in harmony with water.

Aoyama Station. Standing quietly in a residential area, this station is where daily life and the railway lean most closely together. Even the footsteps of commuters morning and night beat a comfortable rhythm as the heartbeat of the community.

Kobari Station. Developing as the center of Niigata City's Nishi Ward, this station is a mysterious space where Showa-era shopping streets and modern townscapes coexist. The sunset viewed from the overpass gently envelops the backs of those hurrying home.

Terao Station. Located in an area carved from ancient sand dunes, the indomitable spirit of those who lived with the soil breathes around this station. Though now a quiet residential area, a faint scent of the sea reaches here, hinting at the proximity of the ocean.

Niigata Daigaku-mae Station. Gathering young intellects, this station is always filled with fresh air and the passion of youths dreaming of the future. The slope leading to the campus is the very trajectory of youth striving to fly over hardships.

Uchino Station. Thriving as a former post town and a key point for river transport, this town possesses a depth that lets one feel layers of history. The old storehouses remaining in front of the station quietly narrate the glory of the era when they led logistics.

Uchino-Nishigaoka Station. Born as a gateway to new residential developments, this station is a newcomer to the Echigo Line's history, but its view from the heights is superb. The city lights below celebrate the beginning of new lives.

Echigo-Akatsuka Station. Situated in a unique landscape of dunes and wetlands, this station is a place where nature's severity and bounty coexist. The farmland stretching from here offers a scene that condenses the blessings of the Echigo Plain.

Sakata Lagoon. This wetland, registered under the Ramsar Convention, is a paradise for migratory birds and a sanctuary conveying the flow of water unchanged since ancient times. In winter, flocks of swans dancing in the dusk possess the beauty of a painting drawn by nature.

Echigo-Sone Station. Serving as the central station for Nishikanbara and growing with agricultural development, this station embodies the sturdy and vigorous spirit of Echigo. The scattered mansions of wealthy farmers prove how fertile this land has been.

Maki Station. Located at the foot of Mt. Kakuda, this station maintains the atmosphere of a temple town while establishing a firm position as a hub for Nishikan Ward. The warm air in front of the station welcomes visiting travelers like old friends.
product_ja:
カーブドッチ・ワイナリー 新潟ワイン
角田山の麓、砂丘地帯に広がる美しいワイナリー「カーブドッチ」。水はけの良い砂地に根を張ったブドウから生まれるワインは、驚くほど軽やかで繊細です。特に「アルバリーニョ」は、日本海の潮風を感じさせるミネラル感と華やかな香りが特徴。新潟の和食や新鮮な魚介類にそっと寄り添う、エレガントな一杯をどうぞ。
product_en:
Curve Dodge Winery Niigata Wine
Curve Dodge is a beautiful winery located in the sand dunes at the foot of Mt. Kakuda. The wines produced from vines rooted in well-drained sandy soil are surprisingly light and delicate. In particular, ``Albariño'' is characterized by its minerality and gorgeous aroma reminiscent of the sea breeze of the Sea of ​​Japan. Enjoy an elegant cup that gently complements Niigata's Japanese cuisine and fresh seafood.
product_fr:
Vin Curve Dodge Winery Niigata
Curve Dodge est un magnifique domaine viticole situé dans les dunes de sable au pied du mont Kakuda. Les vins issus de vignes enracinées dans un sol sableux bien drainé sont étonnamment légers et délicats. En particulier, « Albariño » se caractérise par sa minéralité et son magnifique arôme rappelant la brise marine de la mer du Japon. Savourez une tasse élégante qui complète délicatement la cuisine japonaise et les fruits de mer frais de Niigata.
product_tw:
Curve Dodge Winery 新潟葡萄酒
Curve Dodge 是美麗的酒莊，位於角田山腳下的沙丘中。根植於排水良好的沙質土壤的葡萄藤所釀製的葡萄酒出奇地輕盈細膩。特別是「Albariño」的特色是其礦物味和華麗的香氣，讓人想起日本海的海風。享受優雅的杯子，與新潟的日本料理和新鮮海鮮相得益彰。

text_en: Uwasekigata Park. Spreading with the brave figure of Mt. Kakuda in the background, this park is a palette of colors where seasonal flowers adorn the earth. Especially the "Wara Art" in autumn makes one feel a new form of local love merging farming culture and art.

Iwamuro Station. As the entrance to the historic Iwamuro Onsen, this station possesses both history and dignity, filled with a scent that invites travel. The road from here to the hot spring town is a prologue for shedding daily life and healing mind and body.

Kita-Yoshida Station. Located at the entrance to the industrial city of Yoshida, this station is a mysterious place where the roar of machinery and rural silence intersect. Mt. Yahiko seen beyond the factories provides a sense of an unchanging spiritual home.

Yoshida Station. This hub where the Echigo and Yahiko lines cross in a cruciform is the "Railway Intersection" where travelers envision their next destinations. The shine of the rails stretching in all directions symbolizes the many choices available in life.
product_ja:
燕三条 磨き屋シンジケート タンブラー
世界に誇る金属加工の街、燕市。熟練の研磨師が「鏡面仕上げ」にこだわり抜いたステンレスタンブラーは、まさに職人技の結晶です。内側に施された特殊な磨きにより、ビールを注げばクリーミーで繊細な泡が立ち上がり、喉越しが劇的に変わります。冷たさが持続し、手にするたびに美しさに惚れ惚れする、至福の工芸品です。
product_en:
Tsubamesanjo Shinya Syndicate Tumbler
Tsubame City is a world-class metalworking city. The stainless steel tumbler is a masterpiece of craftsmanship, created by a skilled polisher to achieve a mirror finish. Thanks to the special polishing applied to the inside, when you pour beer, creamy and delicate foam rises, dramatically changing the way it tastes down your throat. It is a blissful craft that stays cold for a long time and makes you fall in love with its beauty every time you hold it in your hands.
product_fr:
Tsubamesanjo Shinya Syndicate Gobelet
La ville de Tsubame est une ville métallurgique de classe mondiale. Le gobelet en acier inoxydable est un chef-d'œuvre artisanal, créé par un polisseur qualifié pour obtenir une finition miroir. Grâce au polissage spécial appliqué à l'intérieur, lorsque vous versez de la bière, une mousse crémeuse et délicate monte, modifiant radicalement son goût dans la gorge. C'est un artisanat merveilleux qui reste froid pendant longtemps et vous fait tomber amoureux de sa beauté à chaque fois que vous le tenez entre vos mains.
product_tw:
燕三條 Shinya Syndicate 玻璃杯
燕市是世界級的金屬加工城市。這款不鏽鋼玻璃杯是工藝傑作，由熟練的拋光師打造而成，達到鏡面效果。由於內部經過特殊拋光，當您倒入啤酒時，奶油般細膩的泡沫會升起，極大地改變您喉嚨裡的味道。這是一個幸福的工藝品，可以長時間保持冰涼，每次握在手中都會讓您愛上它的美麗。

text_en: Minami-Yoshida Station. In this area where residential zones and rural landscapes blend quietly, one can feel the pulse of daily life in Tsubame City most closely. Every time the train doors open, the peaceful scenery brings a sense of tranquility to the traveler's heart.

Aoutzu Station. Walking around the station, traces of old farming villages remain, where the blessings of water that nurtured the Echigo Plain harmonize with the people's lives. The silhouette of Mt. Yahiko in the distance seems to watch over the land gently, like a guardian deity.

Bunsui Station. Formerly known as "Jizodo," this station carries the weight of history, having developed alongside the completion of the Ohkozubunsui diversion channel, a grand project to save the land from the Shinano River's floods. In spring, the cherry blossoms along the tracks form a pink tunnel to bless travelers.

Ohkozubunsui Old Sluice Gate. Known as the "Red Gate," this relic is an iron fortress inhabited by the indomitable spirits of predecessors who challenged Asia's greatest engineering project. Its majestic figure, having watched over the eternal flow, narrates the triumph of those who protected the Echigo Plain.
name_fr: Ancien déversoir mobile de dérivation d'Okawazu

text_en: Teradomari Station. Located slightly away from the sea, this station serves as the gateway to the port town, exuding a unique atmosphere that hints at the scent of the tide. The time spent dreaming of the vast ocean toward Sado Island while on the bus from here is the true essence of travel.
product_ja:
寺泊の干物セット（のどぐろ・真ほっけ）
「魚のアメ横」として名高い寺泊。日本海から揚がる鮮魚を、熟練の職人が一尾ずつ丁寧に干し上げた逸品です。特に「白身のトロ」と称される「のどぐろ」の干物は格別。溢れ出す上質な脂が、凝縮された旨味とともに口の中で溶け合います。日本海の潮風を感じるような、贅沢すぎる朝のひとときを約束してくれるセットです。
product_en:
Teradomari dried fish set (Nodoguro, Mahokke)
Teradomari is famous as the "Ameyoko of fish". This is a masterpiece made from fresh fish from the Sea of ​​Japan, carefully dried one by one by skilled craftsmen. The dried ``nodoguro'' fish, known as ``white fatty tuna,'' is especially special. The overflowing high-quality fat melts in your mouth along with the concentrated flavor. This set promises a luxurious morning experience where you can feel the sea breeze of the Sea of ​​Japan.
product_fr:
Ensemble de poisson séché Teradomari (Nodoguro, Mahokke)
Teradomari est célèbre comme "l'Ameyoko du poisson". Il s'agit d'un chef-d'œuvre élaboré à partir de poissons frais de la mer du Japon, soigneusement séchés un par un par des artisans qualifiés. Le poisson séché « nodoguro », connu sous le nom de « thon blanc gras », est particulièrement spécial. La graisse débordante de haute qualité fond dans la bouche avec la saveur concentrée. Cet ensemble promet une expérience matinale luxueuse où vous pourrez sentir la brise marine de la mer du Japon.

text_en: Teradomari Fish Market Street. Known as the "Ameyoko of Fish," this street is the "stomach of Echigo," lined with an abundance of seafood from the Sea of Japan. The energetic calls of sellers and the savory aroma of grilled fish stimulate the senses and satisfy the traveler's hunger with the finest feast.
name_fr: Rue du marché aux poissons de Teradomari

text_en: Kirihara Station. This quiet, unstaffed station is wrapped in a silence that makes time seem to stand still—a sanctuary for those who love the solitude and freedom of railway travel. The expanse of greenery viewed from the platform promises the ultimate refreshment far from the city.

Ojimaya Station. In this place where the warmth of the station building can still be felt, the pride of having once been a regional center is carefully preserved. Walking the ancient paths nearby, one might hear the echoes of past travelers' footsteps in the faint sound of the wind.

Myohoji Station. As the name suggests, this is the entrance to a historic temple, where a solemn atmosphere and the openness of the countryside exist in mysterious harmony. The train's whistle sounds like a temple bell, making one pray for a safe journey.

Izumozaki Station. Once a thriving port for Kitamaebune ships and the birthplace of the monk Ryokan, this gateway to history carries a deep, layered atmosphere. Heading toward the coast from here, the sunset sinking into the Sea of Japan dyes the traveler's soul in gold.
product_ja:
出雲崎名産 浜焼き（鯛・イカ・地魚）
かつて北前船の寄港地として栄えた出雲崎。浜辺で豪快に串刺しの魚を焼く「浜焼き」の光景は、町の宝です。お取り寄せでは、その鮮度と旨味を閉じ込めた真空パックが人気。炭火の香ばしさを纏った鯛の身は驚くほどふっくらしており、噛むたびに日本海の荒波が育んだ濃厚な脂の甘みが口いっぱいに弾けます。
product_en:
Izumozaki specialty Hamayaki (sea bream, squid, local fish)
Izumozaki once prospered as a port of call for Kitamaebune ships. The sight of ``hamayaki,'' grilling skewered fish on the beach, is a treasure of the town. Vacuum packs are popular for ordering, as they retain their freshness and flavor. The flesh of the sea bream is surprisingly plump with the aroma of charcoal, and each bite fills your mouth with the sweetness of the rich fat nurtured by the rough waves of the Sea of ​​Japan.
product_fr:
Spécialité Izumozaki Hamayaki (daurade, calamar, poisson local)
Izumozaki prospérait autrefois en tant que port d'escale pour les navires Kitamaebune. La vue des « hamayaki », des brochettes de poisson grillées sur la plage, est un trésor de la ville. Les emballages sous vide sont populaires pour la commande, car ils conservent leur fraîcheur et leur saveur. La chair de la daurade est étonnamment charnue avec l'arôme du charbon de bois, et chaque bouchée remplit votre bouche de la douceur de la riche graisse nourrie par les vagues agitées de la mer du Japon.
product_tw:
出雲崎特產濱燒（鯛魚、魷魚、當地魚）
出雲崎曾經作為北前船的停靠港而繁榮。在海灘上烤魚串的「濱燒」是小鎮的瑰寶。真空包裝很受歡迎，因為它們保留了新鮮度和風味。鯛魚的肉質出奇的肥美，帶著木炭的香氣，每一口都充滿了日本海波濤洶湧孕育出來的豐富脂肪的甜味。

text_en: Ryokan Memorial Hall. This hall, where one can touch the modest and warm personality of Ryokan, asks visitors "What is true wealth?" while offering breathtaking views from the heights. Gazing at the shadow of Sado Island below makes one realize the depth of the local history and culture.

Ishiji Station. This station, which still carries memories of the past beach boom, evokes the energy of youth that once filled the platforms in summer. Even now, in its quiet state, the platform creates a beautiful, melancholic scene at dusk like a classic painting.

Raihai Station. Arriving at this station with its unusual name (meaning "worship"), one finds a "village of prayer" where a sacred atmosphere and a simple settlement coexist. Exploring the area while tracing the origin of the station name allows one to touch the roots of Japanese faith.

Futada Mononobe Shrine. This ancient shrine is a hidden historic site in Echigo with ties to the Mononobe clan. The silence of the thick forest purifies the visitor's heart and quietly watches over the safety of those traveling by rail.

Kariwa Station. This area, where a massive energy hub and a traditional village sit side by side, is a symbolic place where modern Japanese industry and tradition intersect. The contrast between the giant facilities and the unchanging rural scenery provides a sense of the reality of modern travel.

Arahama Station. Located in a coastal dune area, this station stands in a unique landscape created by sand and wind, stirring an endless sense of wanderlust. In this place where Kitamaebune once waited for favorable winds, modern rails continue to run with the sound of waves as their companion.

Kashiwasaki Station. Merging with the Shinetsu Main Line, this terminal facing the Sea of Japan possesses a grand dignity suitable for concluding the long journey of the Echigo Line. The sound of the surf envelops the station, and the sight of trains departing for new destinations reflects a courageous spirit.
product_ja:
越後銘菓 網代焼（あじろやき）
柏崎の海を愛する人々が、小魚の形を模して作り上げた明治生まれの銘菓。大正から変わらぬ伝統の味は、うるち米の香ばしさと、小粒ながらもパンチの効いた醤油の風味がたまりません。パリッとした食感の後に広がる、どこか懐かしい磯の香り。お茶請けにはもちろん、お酒のつまみとしても止まらなくなる、柏崎のソウルフードです。
product_en:
Echigo confectionery Ajiroyaki
A famous Meiji-born confection created in the shape of a small fish by people who love the sea in Kashiwazaki. The traditional taste that has remained unchanged since the Taisho era is irresistible, with the aroma of non-glutinous rice and the punchy flavor of soy sauce, even though the grains are small. After the crispy texture, there is a somewhat nostalgic scent of the ocean. It's Kashiwazaki's soul food, and you can enjoy it not only with tea, but also as a snack with alcohol.
product_fr:
Confiserie Echigo Ajiroyaki
Une célèbre confiserie née Meiji créée en forme de petit poisson par des amoureux de la mer à Kashiwazaki. Le goût traditionnel, inchangé depuis l'ère Taisho, est irrésistible, avec l'arôme du riz non gluant et la saveur piquante de la sauce soja, même si les grains sont petits. Après la texture croustillante, on retrouve un parfum un peu nostalgique de l’océan. C'est la nourriture soul de Kashiwazaki, et vous pouvez la déguster non seulement avec du thé, mais aussi comme collation avec de l'alcool.
product_tw:
越後點心網代燒
柏崎熱愛大海的人們將明治時期的著名點心做成小魚形。米粒雖小，但糯米的香氣和醬油的濃鬱味道，從大正時代以來一直保持不變的傳統口味令人難以抗拒。酥脆的口感之後，還有一絲懷舊的海洋氣息。它是柏崎的靈魂食物，不僅可以與茶一起享用，還可以作為下酒的小吃。

text_en: Akasakayama Park. Spreading across the heights overlooking the city, this park is a place of relaxation where seasonal colors harmonize with historic stone pagodas. Gazing at the grand panorama of the Sea of Japan from the observatory, the long path traveled by rail is engraved as a brilliant memory.

Haruna Annaka. This station, which opened in 1997 and symbolizes the rapid delivery of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, actually has a mysterious charm that evokes the ``Showa travel spirit'' in the ``Reiwa era.'' It was once nicknamed the ``unexplored station,'' as it suddenly appeared in the middle of a vast rural landscape, and the contrast between the cutting-edge technology of the Shinkansen and the idyllic scenery of Japan captured the hearts of visitors.

Nowadays, brand new residential areas are expanding around the station, making it a lively place for people commuting by Shinkansen, but once you step outside, you can see the Myogi Mountains and Mt. Asama standing calmly in the distance, giving you a sense of the unchanging beauty of Japan. While thinking about the history of the Shinetsu Main Line that ran through this area, the Shinkansen, a futuristic vehicle, adds new color to Showa era railway travelogues, and is truly the gateway to modern adventure.
product_ja:
荻野屋 峠の釜めし（空釜利用セット・レトルト）
信越本線・横川駅からの伝統を受け継ぐ、日本一有名な駅弁。お取り寄せでは、あの重厚な益子焼の器を自宅で再現できるセットが人気です。秘伝の出汁で炊き上げた鶏肉、椎茸、牛蒡の旨味が渾身の一粒一粒に染み渡っています。蓋を開けた瞬間に立ち昇る、甘じょっぱい湯気の香りは、旅情そのものです。
product_en:
Oginoya Pass pot meal (empty pot set/retort)
Japan's most famous ekiben, which inherits the tradition from Yokogawa Station on the Shinetsu Main Line. Sets that allow you to recreate the heavy Mashiko ware pottery at home are popular on order. The delicious flavor of chicken, shiitake mushrooms, and burdock cooked in a secret soup is permeated into each grain. The sweet and salty aroma of steam that rises the moment you open the lid is the very essence of travel.
product_fr:
Repas en pot Oginoya Pass (ensemble de pots vides/cornue)
L'ekiben le plus célèbre du Japon, qui hérite de la tradition de la gare de Yokogawa sur la ligne principale Shinetsu. Les ensembles qui vous permettent de recréer la poterie lourde Mashiko à la maison sont populaires sur commande. La délicieuse saveur du poulet, des champignons shiitake et de la bardane cuites dans une soupe secrète est imprégnée de chaque grain. L’arôme sucré et salé de la vapeur qui monte dès que vous ouvrez le couvercle est l’essence même du voyage.
product_tw:
荻野屋通鍋飯（空鍋套餐/殺菌鍋）
日本最著名的車站便當，繼承了信越本線橫川站的傳統。可以在家中重現厚重的益子燒陶器的套裝很受歡迎。雞肉、香菇、牛蒡的秘密湯汁的鮮美滲透到每一粒穀物中。打開蓋子的那一刻，一股甜甜鹹鹹的蒸氣香氣瀰漫開來，這就是旅行的精髓。

text_en:
Karuizawa. It has been developed as a summer resort by foreign missionaries since the Meiji period, and has a history of being visited by many literary figures and artists. Once upon a time, this station served as a key point for the Shin-Etsu Main Line to cross the Usui Pass in Abt style, giving us a strong sense of the travel atmosphere of the Golden Age of Railways. Travelers could feel the special bustle of the area as they worked to replace the locomotives.

However, times have changed, and with the opening of the Nagano Shinkansen in the Heisei era, its role has undergone a major transformation. The Abt Road has been abolished, and although it feels a little sad for train fans, modern convenience has greatly improved. The area around the station is bustling with modern conveniences such as outlet malls, but once you step into Kyu Karuizawa, you will find that the quiet atmosphere of the good old days remains, gently retaining the vestiges of the past and attracting the hearts of travelers.
product_ja:
信州産・完熟アミダラ 軽井沢フルーツジャム
避暑地・軽井沢の朝を彩る、果実よりも果実らしい贅沢ジャム。信州産の完熟した果実を、砂糖を極限まで抑えて丁寧に煮詰めています。パンに塗るというより、果実を「載せる」感覚。一口食べれば、高原の爽やかな風と、降り注ぐ太陽を浴びた果実の瑞々しさが口いっぱいに弾けます。
product_en:
Shinshu ripe Amidala Karuizawa fruit jam
A luxurious jam that is more fruit than fruit, brightening up the mornings of Karuizawa, a summer resort. Ripe fruits from Shinshu are carefully boiled down with the lowest possible amount of sugar. Rather than spreading it on bread, it feels more like "putting it on" fruit. When you take a bite, your mouth will be filled with the refreshing breeze of the highlands and the freshness of the fruit, which has been exposed to the shining sun.
product_fr:
Confiture de fruits mûrs Shinshu Amidala Karuizawa
Une confiture luxueuse qui est plus fruitée que fruitée, égayant les matinées de Karuizawa, une station estivale. Les fruits mûrs de Shinshu sont soigneusement bouillis avec le moins de sucre possible. Plutôt que de l’étaler sur du pain, cela ressemble plus à « le mettre sur » des fruits. Lorsque vous prendrez une bouchée, votre bouche sera remplie de la brise rafraîchissante des hauts plateaux et de la fraîcheur des fruits exposés au soleil éclatant.
product_tw:
信州熟阿米達拉輕井澤果醬
比水果更水果的奢華果醬，照亮了避暑勝地輕井澤的早晨。來自信州的成熟水果用盡可能少的糖精心煮沸。與其說是塗在麵包上，不如說是「塗在」水果上。當你咬下一口的時候，你的嘴裡就會充滿高原的清爽微風和經過燦爛陽光照射的水果的新鮮。

text_en: Sakuhei. With the opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, it is a key point for a new railway that was born in this area. This station, which suddenly appeared in the countryside a little away from the old city that was once the center of the Saku region, became the connection point with the Koumi Line and came to play the role of the gateway to the plateau. The Koumi Line, nicknamed the ``Yatsugatake Kogen Line,'' is an atmospheric line that runs at the highest point on the Japanese Railways, reflecting the magnificent nature of each season through its train windows. This place, where the convenience of the Shinkansen and the somewhat nostalgic feeling of traveling by local trains intertwine, gives you a unique atmosphere where modern and Showa coexist. In the spring, the Saku Balloon Festival is held, and travelers can enjoy the colorful balloons that fill the sky.
product_ja:
信州佐久 橘倉酒造「そば焼酎・峠」
信州の澄み切った空気と清冽な水が育んだ、蕎麦の香りを封じ込めた名酒。グラスに注いだ瞬間に広がる、蕎麦の香ばしくも甘い香りに驚かされます。お取り寄せなら、ぜひロックでそのキレを味わってください。信州の蕎麦畑を吹き抜ける風を呑み干すような、清涼感あふれるひとときが楽しめます。
product_en:
Shinshu Saku Tachibana Kura Sake Brewery “Soba Shochu/Toge”
A famous sake with the scent of soba grown in Shinshu's clear air and clear water. You will be surprised by the savory yet sweet aroma of soba that spreads as soon as you pour it into the glass. If you order it, please enjoy its sharpness on the rocks. You can enjoy a refreshing moment like drinking in the breeze blowing through the soba fields of Shinshu.
product_fr:
Brasserie de saké Shinshu Saku Tachibana Kura « Soba Shochu/Toge »
Un saké célèbre au parfum de soba cultivé dans l'air pur et l'eau claire de Shinshu. Vous serez surpris par l'arôme à la fois savoureux et sucré du soba qui se propage dès que vous le versez dans le verre. Si vous le commandez, profitez de sa netteté sur les rochers. Vous pouvez profiter d'un moment rafraîchissant en buvant la brise qui souffle sur les champs de soba de Shinshu.
product_tw:
信州佐久立花藏酒廠“蕎麥燒酒/峠”
帶有信州清澈空氣和清澈海水中生長的蕎麥香味的著名清酒。當你將蕎麥倒入玻璃杯中時，你會驚訝於蕎麥麵的鹹味和甜味。如果您訂購，請享受加冰後的口感。您可以在信州蕎麥田吹過的微風中享受飲酒的清爽時刻。

text_en:
Ueda. This ancient capital, also known as the Little Kyoto of Shinshu, is home to the sturdy castle of the Sanada clan, giving visitors a sense of the weight of history. Access from the metropolitan area has improved significantly with the opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, but the sight of retro vehicles on the Ueda Electric Railway Bessho Line leisurely passing through the city still conveys an idyllic travel atmosphere, as if time has stopped.

This area once prospered for its sericulture industry and was known as the ``Silkworm Capital'', and the buildings and place names that retain its features still remain today, testifying to the industrial background of the past. In front of the station, the Rokumonsen flag of Sanada Yukimura flies, and traditional festivals such as Ueda Shishi and Ueda Wasshoi are a powerful reminder of the vibrancy of this area to the present day.

Iiyama. With the extension of the Hokuriku Shinkansen line, this station has been given a modern look, and with the deep snow-covered mountains of Shinetsu in the background, it has a resolute presence. However, behind the scenes, you can catch a glimpse of the Iiyama Line, which runs along the leisurely flow of the Chikuma River, and its simple appearance steeped in history and travel spirit. This area has been a key location in northern Shinano since ancient times, and is home to the lives of people who have coexisted with the harsh conditions of heavy snowfall. The station building uses a lot of local wood, and the warm space quietly tells visitors about Iiyama's rich nature and culture. The gateway to this area, which shows different expressions throughout the seasons, such as the bustle of snow festivals and the dazzling field of rape blossoms in spring, continues to create new encounters and nostalgic memories.
product_ja:
信州 飯山産 雪熟成幻の米（コシヒカリ）
日本有数の豪雪地帯、飯山。厳しい冬を越え、雪解け水で育まれたこのお米は、粘りと甘みが別格です。雪室でじっくりと熟成させることで、さらに旨味が増し、冷めても一粒一粒が輝きを失いません。炊きたての真っ白な輝きは、まさに飯山の美しい雪景色。一度食べれば「幻」と呼ばれる理由がわかります。
product_en:
Snow-aged fantasy rice (Koshihikari) from Iiyama, Shinshu
Iiyama is one of the heaviest snowfall areas in Japan. This rice, which has survived a harsh winter and is grown with water from melted snow, is unique in its stickiness and sweetness. By aging slowly in the snow room, the flavor is further enhanced, and each grain retains its luster even after cooling down. The pure white glow of freshly cooked rice is just like the beautiful snowy scenery of Iiyama. Once you try it, you'll understand why it's called "phantom".
product_fr:
Riz fantaisie vieilli en neige (Koshihikari) d'Iiyama, Shinshu
Iiyama est l'une des régions où les chutes de neige sont les plus importantes au Japon. Ce riz, qui a survécu à un hiver rigoureux et qui est cultivé avec l'eau de la fonte des neiges, est unique par son caractère collant et sucré. En vieillissant lentement dans la chambre à neige, la saveur est encore renforcée et chaque grain conserve son éclat même après refroidissement. La lueur blanche pure du riz fraîchement cuit ressemble au magnifique paysage enneigé d’Iiyama. Une fois que vous l’aurez essayé, vous comprendrez pourquoi on l’appelle « fantôme ».
product_tw:
信州飯山產雪熟夢幻米（越光）
飯山是日本降雪量最大的地區之一。這種米熬過了嚴冬，用融雪的水培育而成，具有獨特的黏性和甜味。透過在雪室中緩慢陳釀，風味進一步增強，即使冷卻後，每粒穀物仍保持其光澤。剛煮熟的米飯潔白的光芒，就像飯山美麗的雪景一樣。一旦你嘗試過，你就會明白為什麼它被稱為「幻影」。

text_en:
Kurobe Unazuki Onsen. Once you step off the brand new platform of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, you will find yourself in the majestic heart of the Tateyama Mountain Range. Although this station opened in 2015, it invites you to a place filled with the romance of the Showa era. It is the gateway to the Unazuki hot spring village, which once had a magnificent history of power development that supported Japan's rapid economic growth, as well as the Unazuki hot spring village, which was a place of relaxation for literary figures and artists.

In front of the station, Shin-Kurobe Station of the Toyama Chihou Railway stands parallel to the elevated Shinkansen, and further back from there, the trolley train of the Kurobe Gorge Railway still makes its unchanging whistle. The sight of the train weaving its way through a steep gorge is a reminder of the travel spirit that has been passed down since the early Showa era, and it gives us a sense of the luxury of taking in the scenery at a leisurely pace, something that the speed of modern times has almost forgotten. The Shinkansen, the latest convenience of civilization, is a station that plays a truly profound role in transporting you to the original scenery of good old Japan.

Toyama. With the opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, this city became a new transportation hub on the Sea of ​​Japan side, and the city is still deeply engraved with the remains of the old Hokuriku Main Line and the history of the local line that once extended to Toyama Port. Blessed with the rich blessings of the Jinzu River, this area is home to the strong spirit of the people who traveled all over the country selling medicine in ancient times.From the Meiji era onwards, the railway supported the development of the town. The tram that runs lightly in front of the station creates a nostalgic yet new scenery, as if you have traveled back in time to the Showa era.

There are still many old merchant houses in the city, and the harmony of rich nature and history gives you a true sense of the original Japanese landscape. Although the flow of people has changed dramatically with the opening of the Shinkansen, Toyama Bay's fresh seafood and traditional culture such as the Owara Kaze Bon Festival continue to attract people throughout the ages. When you stand on the platform, you can feel the real thrill of traveling by train, where the past and present intertwine.
product_ja:
鱒之寿し（ますのすし）二重
立山連峰の雪解け水が流れる神通川のほとりで育まれた、富山のソウルフード。お取り寄せでもその鮮やかな朱色は健在です。笹を解いた瞬間の清々しい香りと、適度に締められた鱒の旨味、そして粘りのある富山米が見事な調和を見せます。二重（ふたえ）なら、その厚みと満足感も倍増。家族で囲む食卓に華を添えます。
product_en:
Trout sushi (masu no sushi) double
Toyama's soul food is grown on the banks of the Jinzu River, where water flows from the melting snow of the Tateyama Mountain Range. Its bright vermilion color is still intact even when ordered. The refreshing scent of the bamboo leaves, the flavor of the trout, and the sticky Toyama rice create a perfect harmony. If it is double-sided (futae), the thickness and satisfaction will be doubled. Add a touch of beauty to your family dining table.
product_fr:
Sushi à la truite (masu no sushi) double
La nourriture de l'âme de Toyama est cultivée sur les rives de la rivière Jinzu, là où l'eau coule de la fonte des neiges de la chaîne de montagnes Tateyama. Sa couleur vermillon éclatante est toujours intacte même lors de la commande. Le parfum rafraîchissant des feuilles de bambou, la saveur de la truite et le riz gluant Toyama créent une harmonie parfaite. S'il est double face (futae), l'épaisseur et la satisfaction seront doublées. Ajoutez une touche de beauté à votre table à manger familiale.
product_tw:
鱒魚壽司（masu no sushi）雙人份
富山的靈魂食物生長在神通川河畔，水從立山中融雪流淌而來。即使在訂購時，其明亮的朱紅色仍然完好無損。竹葉的清香、鱒魚的鮮味和富山糯米飯的完美和諧。如果是雙面（futae）的話，厚度和滿意度都會加倍。為您的家庭餐桌增添一抹美麗。

text_en: New Takaoka. Although it is a station with a short history, having been created with the opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, this area has been the gateway to Takaoka, which has flourished since ancient times. Although the station building is modern, once you step outside, travelers are greeted by a cityscape filled with traditional culture, represented by Shokoji Temple, a national treasure with a history of 1200 years, and the gorgeous Takaoka Mikurumayama Festival. The craftsmanship of Takaoka copperware and lacquerware has been passed down to the present day, creating a unique atmosphere where a new transportation hub meets the atmosphere of an ancient capital. It also functions as a transfer point to the Manyo Line, serves as a base for new travel in Hokuriku, and plays an important role in conveying the charm of the ancient capital.

Kanazawa. This land, which once boasted the prosperity of Kaga Hyakumangoku, was a key hub in the Hokuriku region and has fostered a unique culture backed by the rich blessings of the Sea of ​​Japan. Kanazawa Station welcomes travelers with its modern ``Tzumi Gate'' and ``Hospitality Dome,'' and its imposing appearance demonstrates the city's perfect blend of tradition and innovation.

Although the taste of travel has changed since the days of the beautiful Hokuriku Main Line and the opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, the tranquil beauty of Kenrokuen and the atmosphere of Higashi Chaya District continue to capture the hearts of visitors. The craftsmanship that can be seen in the elegant Kaga Yuzen and sparkling gold leaf crafts also strongly conveys the spirit of this city. On rainy days, this city has an even more calm atmosphere, making you feel a deep sense of travel.
product_ja:
加賀銘菓 まめや金澤萬久 金箔万久の「金かすてら」
加賀百万石の雅を今に伝える、金箔を贅沢にあしらったカステラ。職人が一枚一枚丁寧に貼り付けた金箔は、もはや芸術品。しっとりとした卵のコクが広がる生地は、お取り寄せでもその食感を失いません。華やかな見た目は、お祝いの席にも最適。金沢の美意識をそのまま箱に詰め込んだような逸品です。
product_en:
Kaga Famous Confectionery Mameya Kanazawa Mankyu Kinpaku Mankyu's "Kinkastera"
Castella luxuriously decorated with gold leaf, which conveys the elegance of Kaga Hyakumangoku. Each piece of gold leaf is carefully pasted on by a craftsman, making it a work of art. The moist dough with the richness of eggs retains its texture even when ordered. The gorgeous appearance is perfect for celebrations. It is a masterpiece that seems to have the aesthetic sense of Kanazawa packed into a box.
product_fr:
Kaga Célèbre confiserie Mameya Kanazawa Mankyu Kinpaku "Kinkastera" de Mankyu
Castella luxueusement décorée de feuilles d'or, qui transmettent l'élégance de Kaga Hyakumangoku. Chaque pièce de feuille d'or est soigneusement collée par un artisan, ce qui en fait une œuvre d'art. La pâte moelleuse à la richesse des œufs conserve sa texture même lorsqu'elle est commandée. L'apparence magnifique est parfaite pour les célébrations. C'est un chef-d'œuvre qui semble avoir le sens esthétique de Kanazawa emballé dans une boîte.
product_tw:
加賀名品點心金澤豆也金箔萬久的“Kinkastera”
卡斯特拉（Castella）以金箔裝飾，展現奢華，展現加賀百萬石的優雅氣質。每一片金箔都經過工匠精心粘貼，使其成為一件藝術品。即使訂購後，帶有豐富雞蛋的濕潤麵團也能保持其質地。華麗的外觀非常適合慶祝活動。這是一件彷彿將金澤美裝進盒子裡的傑作。

text_en: Komatsu. This area, which spreads out to the south of the Kaga Plain, flourished in ancient times as the castle town of Komatsu Castle and as a strategic point on the Hokuriku Expressway. Since the opening of the Hokuriku Line in 1890, Komatsu Station has carved out a history as an artery that supports the local economy and culture. If you walk through the shopping street in front of the station that reminds you of the bustle of the past, you will be captivated by Kutani ware, a traditional craft from Ishikawa Prefecture, as well as a variety of other specialty products nurtured by the rich water and land. In recent years, the elevated station has taken on a modern look, but retains some nostalgic vestiges of the Showa era, creating a unique atmosphere where history and the future intersect.

Kaga hot springs. Since its opening in the Meiji era, this area, once known as Sakumi Station, has served as an important node on the Hokuriku Main Line and as a gateway to Kaga's three hot springs, such as Yamashiro, Yamanaka, and Katayamazu, and has continued to transport many hot spring bathers and travelers. The renaming of the station truly symbolizes the region's rich hot spring culture and the development of the tourism industry, giving visitors a sense of peace and anticipation. In recent years, with the extension and opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, the station building has been renovated splendidly, creating a modern space where you can casually enjoy local traditional crafts and gourmet food. This station, where old and new railways intersect, is a key point for travel, connecting Kaga's history and future. It is a very moving place where you can fully experience the feeling of traveling by train along the Hokuriku route.

Awara Onsen. This station, once known as Kanazu Station, was a key hub in the Hokuriku region, and since the Showa era it has been a gateway to the hot springs where the scent of hot springs wafts through the air. Now, in the Reiwa era, when the Hokuriku Shinkansen has entered the station and the conventional line has been renovated into the ``Happi Line Fukui'' station building, I feel a mixture of the spirit of travelers of yesteryear and hope for the future. Ashihara Onsen, famous for its beautifying hot springs, warmly welcomes visitors with its seasonal atmosphere, and delights travelers with Echizen crabs in the winter and fresh seafood from Mikuni Port in the summer. This area, where old and new railways intersect, gives you a sense of the timeless romance of railways.

Fukui. This area, where the Hokuriku Main Line runs leisurely through, was once a strategic point on the artery leading to the Sea of ​​Japan. The railways built at the end of the Meiji period brought a certain vitality to the area of ​​Echizen, transporting countless travelers and supporting logistics. Fukui Station, in particular, has always been a bustling place with many people coming and going as it serves as the gateway to the fertile plains nurtured by the Kuzuryu River and as a starting point for the sacred site of dinosaur fossils. The wave of the Shinkansen extension has changed the appearance of conventional lines, but the love of railway travel that continues to be a part of people's lives is still alive in this area. Enjoying local specialties such as Echizen crab and sauce cutlet bowl, and experiencing the grandeur of the dinosaur museum, your journey will leave you with unforgettable memories.
product_ja:
越前名産 焼き鯖寿司（スター丸）
新幹線開業でさらに注目が集まる福井の看板娘。肉厚の鯖を黄金色に焼き上げ、福井県産米の酢飯に載せた逸品です。鯖とご飯の間に挟まれた「生姜」が、濃厚な脂をスッキリと引き締め、一度食べ始めると手が止まりません。冷えても硬くならないよう計算された焼きの技術に、バイヤーも唸るしかありません。
product_en:
Echizen specialty grilled mackerel sushi (star round)
Fukui's poster girl is attracting even more attention with the opening of the Shinkansen. This is a masterpiece of thick mackerel grilled to a golden brown color and served over vinegared rice made from Fukui Prefecture rice. The ``ginger'' sandwiched between the mackerel and rice makes the rich fat taste refreshing, and once you start eating it, you won't be able to stop eating it. Buyers can't help but be impressed by the baking technique, which has been carefully calculated to prevent the cake from becoming hard even when it gets cold.
product_fr:
Sushi de maquereau grillé, spécialité Echizen (rond étoilé)
L'égérie de Fukui attire encore plus l'attention avec l'ouverture du Shinkansen. Il s'agit d'un chef-d'œuvre de maquereau épais grillé jusqu'à obtenir une couleur brun doré et servi sur du riz vinaigré à base de riz de la préfecture de Fukui. Le « gingembre » pris en sandwich entre le maquereau et le riz donne à ce riche goût de graisse un goût rafraîchissant, et une fois que vous aurez commencé à le manger, vous ne pourrez plus vous arrêter de le manger. Les acheteurs ne peuvent qu'être impressionnés par la technique de cuisson, soigneusement calculée pour éviter que le gâteau ne durcisse même lorsqu'il fait froid.
product_tw:
越前特產烤青花魚壽司（星圓）
隨著新幹線的開通，福井的海報女郎更加受到關注。這是將厚厚的鯖魚烤至金黃色，搭配福井縣米製成的醋飯的傑作。鯖魚和米飯之間夾著的“生薑”，讓濃鬱的油脂口感清爽，一吃就停不下來。買家們不禁對烘焙技術印象深刻，其烘焙技術經過精心計算，即使蛋糕變冷也不會變硬。

text_en: Takefu Echizen. Although it is a brand new station that was born in the Reiwa era with the extension of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, its name has echoes of the old Echizen Province, and it has a deep meaning in the hearts of travelers. Located in Echizen City, Fukui Prefecture, this area is home to artisans with a thousand-year tradition of making Echizen Washi paper and cutlery, and is bustling with elegant events such as the Takefu Chrysanthemum Dolls in the fall.Even though the waves of modernization have swept over the area, it still retains a strong trace of Japan's original landscape and culture. This station, where the changes brought about by the Shinkansen and the unchanging feelings of the local area intertwine, makes you feel both hope for the future and the unforgettable travel spirit of the Showa era.

Tsuruga. With the opening of the Hokuriku Shinkansen, this area is showing off its new railway face, and has prospered since ancient times as a gateway to the continent and as a key location on the Hokuriku Main Line. It is a moving reminder that Tsuruga Port Station was once famous for its dead section where trains switched between direct current and alternating current, and that it was also an international port with a history of connecting with the Trans-Siberian Railway.

The weight of history carried by the sea breeze is certainly alive in the brilliance of the new station building. As soon as you step off the station, you'll be greeted by seafood from the Sea of ​​Japan and a shopping street filled with a nostalgic, friendly atmosphere. In Tsuruga, where the old and new intertwine, you can feel the travel spirit as you touch the depth of the stories that have been woven by railways.
product_ja:
敦賀名産 昆布の詰め合わせ（奥井海生堂）
北前船がもたらした「食の歴史」の終着点、敦賀。創業150年を誇る名店の昆布は、単なる調味料ではなく主役です。蔵で数年寝かせた「蔵囲昆布」の芳醇な香りと、とろけるような口当たりの「とろろ昆布」。これがあれば、自宅の味噌汁や煮物が一瞬にして割烹の味へと昇華します。敦賀の歴史を味わう贅沢なセットです。
product_en:
Assorted Tsuruga specialty kelp (Okui Kaiseido)
Tsuruga is the final destination of the "history of food" brought about by the Kitamaebune. Kombu, a famous restaurant that has been in business for 150 years, is not just a seasoning, but the main ingredient. ``Tororo konbu'' has a mellow aroma and a melt-in-the-mouth texture from ``Kuraoi konbu'' that has been aged in the warehouse for several years. With this, your home-made miso soup and stews will instantly transform into a Japanese-style dish. A luxurious set that lets you enjoy the history of Tsuruga.
product_fr:
Assortiment de varech de spécialité Tsuruga (Okui Kaiseido)
Tsuruga est la destination finale de « l'histoire de la nourriture » provoquée par le Kitamaebune. Le Kombu, un célèbre restaurant en activité depuis 150 ans, n'est pas seulement un assaisonnement, mais l'ingrédient principal. Le « Tororo konbu » a un arôme moelleux et une texture fondante issu du « Kuraoi konbu » qui a vieilli en entrepôt pendant plusieurs années. Grâce à cela, votre soupe miso et vos ragoûts faits maison se transformeront instantanément en un plat de style japonais. Un ensemble luxueux qui vous permet de profiter de l'histoire de Tsuruga.
product_tw:
敦賀特產海帶什錦（奧井海生堂）
敦賀是北前船帶來的「美食史」的最終歸宿。昆布是一家有著150年歷史的名店，它不只是一種調味料，而是主料。 「Tororo昆布」具有醇厚的香氣和入口即化的口感，源自於在倉庫中陳釀數年的「Kuraoi昆布」。這樣，您自製的味噌湯和燉菜就會立即變成日式菜餚。享受敦賀歷史的豪華套裝。

text_en:
Ueno.

This is the ``Gateway to the North,'' where thousands of people have announced their departure for the distant Tohoku, Shinetsu, and Joban regions. Standing on the platform, you can still feel the atmosphere of the Showa era, where the echoes of distant train whistles and the passionate feelings of people leaving their hometowns intertwine.

Since its opening in 1885, Ueno Station has continued to be the starting point of the main artery that supports Japan's modernization and regional development. During the post-war reconstruction period, mass employment trains departed from rural areas to Tokyo, and scenes of people saying farewell to their families have been etched on the platform of this station many times. Just imagining the night train carrying the hopes and anxieties of young people bound for Tokyo, quietly disappearing into darkness under the night sky, makes my heart warm.

Of course, times have changed, and the Tohoku Shinkansen has shifted its role from above-ground platforms to elevated platforms, and the landscape of travel has changed dramatically. However, the lively Ameyoko shopping street spreads out in front of the station, and adjacent to the National Museum of Western Art and other cultural facilities, it attracts visitors with its diverse charms. In recent years, coupled with the popularity of pandas at the zoo, it has become even more popular.

Still, traces of the good old days are still alive in the stained glass at the central ticket gate and in every corner of the dimly lit passageways on the ground platform. From here in Ueno, I want to go on a journey that reminds me of all the places in Japan.

Omiya. This area, known as the heart of Japan's railway network, has grown in importance since the opening of the Japan Railway's First Section Line in 1891, as a major artery through which numerous vehicles travel. As a branching point for the Tohoku Shinkansen and Joetsu Shinkansen, as well as a hub station for all conventional lines, this station is bustling with activity all day long, and is truly a terminal station where travel sentiment and expectations intertwine.

Standing on the station platform, you can see the majestic sight of the Shinkansen and conventional lines constantly arriving and departing, giving you a first-hand feel of the dynamism of railways. After a time when steam locomotives once made the sky hazy with smoke, the state-of-the-art trains that quietly roll by now support Japan's industry and people's lives, a symbol of the changing times.

The place name Omiya is said to come from Hikawa Shrine, the first shrine in Musashi Province, and its sacred history and the development of railways since modern times have fostered a unique culture in this area. It has a particularly deep history as a railway town, and the adjacent Omiya General Rolling Stock Center is a temple of railway technology that has produced and repaired many famous cars. The Railway Museum, which tells the story of this history, has become a major tourist destination that attracts a wide range of people, from families to railway fans. In recent years, the area around the station has been redeveloped, and the townscape, which blends modern charm and tradition, offers visitors new discoveries.

On the morning of my departure, I buy an ekiben at Omiya Station and think about my next destination. Even in such a small act, the history of this place and the activities of its people are condensed.
product_ja:
さいたま銘菓 氷川餅（ひかわもち）
武蔵一宮・氷川神社の門前で愛され続ける、伝統の味わい。お取り寄せ可能な「氷川餅」は、埼玉県産の良質な米を使い、職人が丹念に搗き上げた逸品です。きめ細やかでコシのある餅に、上品な甘さの餡が絶妙に調和します。大宮の活気ある門前町の風景と、清々しい神社の空気を感じさせる、心安らぐ日本の味です。
product_en:
Saitama famous confectionery Hikawamochi
A traditional taste that continues to be loved in front of the gates of Musashi Ichinomiya and Hikawa Shrine. "Hikawa Mochi", which can be ordered, is a masterpiece that is carefully pounded by craftsmen using high-quality rice from Saitama Prefecture. The fine and chewy mochi blends perfectly with the elegant sweetness of the bean paste. It is a comforting Japanese taste that evokes the view of Omiya's lively temple town and the refreshing atmosphere of a shrine.
product_fr:
Célèbre confiserie de Saitama Hikawamochi
Un goût traditionnel qui continue d'être apprécié devant les portes du Musashi Ichinomiya et du sanctuaire Hikawa. Le « Hikawa Mochi », qui peut être commandé, est un chef-d'œuvre soigneusement pilé par des artisans utilisant du riz de haute qualité de la préfecture de Saitama. Le mochi fin et moelleux se marie parfaitement à la douceur élégante de la pâte de haricots. C'est un goût japonais réconfortant qui évoque la vue sur la ville-temple animée d'Omiya et l'atmosphère rafraîchissante d'un sanctuaire.
product_tw:
埼玉縣著名糕點冰川持
在武藏一宮和冰川神社的門前依然受到人們喜愛的傳統風味。可以訂購的「冰川麻糬」是工匠們使用埼玉縣產的優質大米精心搗碎而成的傑作。細膩而有嚼勁的麻糬與豆沙的優雅甜味完美融合。這是一種令人心曠神怡的日式味道，讓人想起大宮熱鬧的寺廟小鎮的景色和神社的清新氛圍。

text_en: Kumagaya. This station stands proudly at a strategic point where the Takasaki Line crosses the Tone River and runs through the plains of Kita Musashi. During the Edo period, this area prospered as the eighth post town on the 69 Nakasendo routes, counting from Edo, and was a place where goods and people continued to come and go.With the opening of the Takasaki Line in 1898 and the connection with the Chichibu Railway, the area solidified its importance as a transportation hub. The enthusiasm of the summer Uchiwa Festival is still alive and well, and even in the Reiwa era, it retains the bustle of the past and an atmosphere that evokes nostalgia in the hearts of travelers. It serves as a stop for the Shinkansen, and its continued development gives us a sense of the history of railways and hope for the future.

product_ja:
五家宝（ごかぼう）
「暑い街」熊谷で江戸時代から愛される、埼玉三大銘菓の一つ。きな粉の香ばしさと、サクッとしたおこしの食感、そして水飴の優しい甘さが口の中で渾然一体となります。無添加で体に優しく、噛むほどに大豆の豊かな風味が広がる様は、まさに質実剛健な熊谷の風土そのもの。お茶の時間が贅沢に変わる、素朴ながらも奥深いお菓子です。
product_en:
Five heirloom treasures
One of Saitama's three major sweets, loved since the Edo period in the "hot town" of Kumagaya. The aroma of soybean flour, the crispy texture of soybean flour, and the gentle sweetness of starch syrup blend harmoniously in your mouth. It is additive-free and gentle on the body, and the rich flavor of the soybeans spreads as you chew it, which is a perfect example of Kumagaya's simple and sturdy climate. A simple yet profound sweet that will transform your tea time into a luxurious one.
product_fr:
Cinq trésors d'héritage
L'une des trois douceurs majeures de Saitama, appréciée depuis l'époque d'Edo dans la « ville chaude » de Kumagaya. L'arôme de la farine de soja, la texture croustillante de la farine de soja et la douce douceur du sirop d'amidon se mélangent harmonieusement en bouche. Il ne contient aucun additif et est doux pour le corps, et la riche saveur du soja se propage au fur et à mesure que vous le mâchez, ce qui est un parfait exemple du climat simple et robuste de Kumagaya. Une douceur simple mais profonde qui transformera votre tea time en un moment luxueux.
product_tw:
五件傳家寶
埼玉三大甜點之一，自江戶時代起就深受「熱門小鎮」熊谷的喜愛。黃豆粉的香氣、黃豆粉的酥脆口感、糖漿的溫和甜味在口中和諧地融合在一起。無添加，對身體溫和，咀嚼時散發出濃鬱的大豆香味，完美體現了熊谷淳樸而堅固的氣候。一款簡單而深刻的甜點，讓您的下午茶時間變得奢華。

text_en:
Honjo Waseda. It is a relatively new station that was born at the dawn of the 21st century in this area where the Joetsu Shinkansen runs through with its roar. The name comes from the ancient post town of Honjo and Waseda University, which has a vast campus.

Although it opened in 2004, a long time since the golden age of railway travel in the Showa era, the area around this station is dotted with scenery reminiscent of the bustling Nakasendo road that connected Musashi and Ueno, and still conveys a somewhat nostalgic atmosphere. The convenience brought by the Shinkansen greatly contributes to the revitalization of the region, and it offers a unique travel experience that combines the good old Japanese scenery with the new breath of academia and industry. There are fields surrounding it, and mountains can be seen in the distance. It is a truly interesting place, where each time the Shinkansen arrives in the silence, expectations for the future and nostalgia for the unchanging nature intertwine.
product_ja:
本庄名物 児玉の本格つるし雛うどん
本庄・児玉地区に伝わる、小麦の文化を象徴する逸品。地元産の小麦「さとのそら」を贅沢に使用し、絹のように滑らかで、それでいて力強いコシを持つ麺に仕上げています。茹で上がりの艶やかな白さは、本庄の豊かな大地が育んだ誇り。小麦本来の甘みと香りが強く、シンプルに醤油と薬味だけで味わっていただきたい、土地の魂が宿る一杯です。
product_en:
Honjo specialty Kodama's authentic Tsurushi Hina Udon
A masterpiece that symbolizes the wheat culture that has been passed down in the Honjo and Kodama areas. We use a generous amount of locally grown wheat, ``Sato no Sora,'' to create noodles that are silky smooth and yet have a strong chewiness. The glossy white color when boiled is the pride of Honjo's rich land. It is a cup full of the spirit of the land that has the natural sweetness and aroma of wheat, and should be enjoyed simply with just soy sauce and seasonings.
product_fr:
Spécialité Honjo L'authentique Tsurushi Hina Udon de Kodama
Un chef-d'œuvre qui symbolise la culture du blé transmise dans les régions de Honjo et Kodama. Nous utilisons une quantité généreuse de blé cultivé localement, « Sato no Sora », pour créer des nouilles soyeuses et pourtant très moelleuses. La couleur blanche brillante une fois bouillie est la fierté de la riche terre de Honjo. C'est une tasse pleine de l'esprit de la terre qui a la douceur et l'arôme naturels du blé, et qui doit être dégustée simplement avec de la sauce soja et des assaisonnements.
product_tw:
本莊特產兒玉正宗鶴烏龍麵
象徵本莊、兒玉地區傳承的小麥文化的傑作。我們大量使用當地種植的小麥“佐藤之空”，製作出絲般柔滑且嚼勁十足的麵條。煮出來的白色光澤是本莊富饒土地的驕傲。這是一杯充滿土地精神的酒，具有小麥的天然甜味和香氣，只需醬油和調味料即可簡單享用。

text_en: Takasaki. This city, located at the northwestern tip of the Kanto Plain, has flourished as a strategic point on the Nakasendo route since ancient times, and since the Meiji era has played a role as a railway node. The Joetsu Line, Shin-Etsu Main Line, Ryomo Line, and Joshin Electric Railway stretch out to various locations like blood vessels, giving you a sense of why they are the heart of transportation. Although it is now a strategic point where the Hokuriku and Joetsu Shinkansen lines intersect, the train whistles of the D51 and C61 still tempt travellers, and the memories of the Showa era, when the railways were once glorious, are still alive. The various festivals held throughout the year and the culture known as Takasaki Daruma no Sato also convey the vitality of this area.
product_ja:
焼きまんじゅう（ほたかや・冷凍セット）
群馬県民のソウルフードが、ご家庭で熱々に！ふかふかの白い素まんじゅうを、甘じょっぱい濃厚な味噌だれで焼き上げる高崎の味。お取り寄せなら、自宅でタレを塗って焼く「体験」もセットで楽しめます。焦げた味噌の香ばしさが部屋中に広がれば、そこはもう高崎の縁日。一度食べれば病みつきになる、力強い上州の恵みです。
product_en:
Grilled Manju (Hotakaya/Frozen Set)
Gunma prefecture's soul food is served piping hot at home! A taste of Takasaki, where fluffy white steamed buns are grilled with a sweet and salty rich miso sauce. If you order it, you can also enjoy the "experience" of coating it with sauce and baking it at home as a set. When the aroma of burnt miso spreads throughout the room, it's already a festival in Takasaki. It is a powerful bounty of Joshu that you will be addicted to once you taste it.
product_fr:
Manju grillé (Hotakaya/Ensemble surgelé)
La soul food de la préfecture de Gunma est servie très chaude à la maison ! Un avant-goût du Takasaki, où des petits pains blancs moelleux cuits à la vapeur sont grillés avec une riche sauce miso sucrée et salée. Si vous le commandez, vous pouvez également profiter de « l'expérience » de l'enrober de sauce et de le cuire à la maison sous forme d'ensemble. Lorsque l'arôme du miso brûlé se répand dans la pièce, c'est déjà un festival à Takasaki. C'est une puissante générosité de Joshu dont vous deviendrez accro une fois que vous y aurez goûté.
product_tw:
烤饅頭（穗高屋/冷凍套餐）
群馬縣的靈魂美食在家就能熱騰騰地享用！高崎的味道，蓬鬆的白色饅頭與甜鹹濃鬱的味噌醬一起烤製。如果點了，還可以享受塗上醬汁、在家烤成套餐的「體驗」。當燒焦的味噌香氣瀰漫整個房間時，高崎已經是一個節日了。這是上州的強大恩惠，一旦品嚐就會上癮。

text_en: Jomo Plateau. This station, which was founded in 1980 with the opening of the Joetsu Shinkansen, is a truly interesting place where the fast flow from the city center intersects with the gentle flow of the mountainous region of Gunma. The Shinkansen travels through the area in a flash, but once you get off the train, you'll be greeted with a magnificent view of Mt. Tanigawa in the background, a quiet reminder of the prosperity of the Showa era, when the area was once crowded with hot spring bathers and skiers. The fact that the name of the station refers to a wide area is proof that this is the gateway to the rich nature of the headwaters of the Tone River and a hot spring village that has been around since ancient times. Although it is a transportation artery for a new era, it somehow evokes a nostalgic feeling of traveling by train.
product_ja:
みなかみ産 育風堂の生ハム「はるな」
谷川岳を望む冷涼な気候が育んだ、国産生ハムの傑作。群馬県産の豚肉を使い、利根川源流の清らかな空気の中でじっくりと長期熟成させています。透き通るような身は、口に入れた瞬間に上質な脂が体温で溶け出し、凝縮された肉の旨味と熟成香が鼻を抜けます。ワインとの相性は抜群。みなかみの森の恵みを、食卓へお届けします。
product_en:
Ikufudo's raw ham from Minakami "Haruna"
A masterpiece of domestic prosciutto produced in the cool climate overlooking Mt. Tanigawa. We use pork from Gunma Prefecture and carefully age it for a long period of time in the clean air of the headwaters of the Tone River. The moment you put the translucent meat in your mouth, the high-quality fat begins to melt at your body temperature, and the concentrated flavor of the meat and aged aroma will pass through your nose. Excellent compatibility with wine. We deliver the blessings of the Minakami Forest to your dining table.
product_fr:
Jambon cru d'Ikufudo de Minakami "Haruna"
Un chef-d'œuvre de prosciutto domestique produit dans le climat frais surplombant le mont Tanigawa. Nous utilisons du porc de la préfecture de Gunma et le faisons vieillir soigneusement pendant une longue période dans l'air pur du cours supérieur de la rivière Tone. Dès que vous mettez la viande translucide dans votre bouche, la graisse de haute qualité commence à fondre à la température de votre corps, et la saveur concentrée de la viande et l'arôme vieilli passeront par votre nez. Excellente compatibilité avec le vin. Nous livrons les bénédictions de la forêt de Minakami à votre table à manger.
product_tw:
水上生不動火腿“榛名”
俯瞰谷川山、氣候涼爽的國產火腿的傑作。使用群馬縣產的豬肉，在利根川源頭的潔淨空氣中長時間精心熟成。當你將半透明的肉放入口中的那一刻，優質脂肪在你的體溫下開始融化，濃濃的肉味和陳年香氣撲鼻而來。與葡萄酒的相容性極佳。我們將水上森林的恩惠送到您的餐桌上。

text_en:
Echigo Yuzawa. After passing through the difficult Shimizu Tunnel on the Joetsu Line, you will finally arrive at the gateway to snowy country. It was once known as a hot spring resort, and after the ski boom arrived after the war, it developed into a resort area that welcomed many people from the Tokyo metropolitan area. The worldview of the Snow Country depicted by Yasunari Kawabata is still deeply rooted in the atmosphere of this area, and each time you visit, you will feel a strong literary flavor.

With the opening of the Shinkansen, access has improved significantly, and the station building is also equipped with ``Ponshukan'' where you can enjoy Echigo's famous sake and hot spring facilities, making your trip even more enjoyable. Echigo-Yuzawa, which shows off its beautiful expressions throughout the four seasons, as well as the silver world of winter, is a place full of charm that perfectly blends the travel atmosphere of the good old Showa era with the vibrancy of modern times.
product_ja:
南魚沼産コシヒカリ（塩沢地区・特別栽培米）
日本一の米どころ、その中でも最高峰と称される「塩沢地区」のコシヒカリ。豪雪がもたらす清らかな雪解け水と、激しい寒暖差が、一粒一粒に圧倒的な甘みと粘りを蓄えさせます。炊きたての艶はまるで真珠のよう。おかずが要らないほど力強い米の旨味は、まさに雪国の執念が結実した究極の芸術品。これぞ、日本の主食の頂点です。
product_en:
Koshihikari from Minamiuonuma (Shiozawa district, specially cultivated rice)
Koshihikari is produced in the Shiozawa area, which is said to be the best rice producer in Japan. The pure snowmelt water brought about by heavy snowfall and the drastic temperature difference create an overwhelming sweetness and stickiness in each grain. The luster of freshly cooked rice is like pearls. The flavor of the rice is so strong that you don't even need a side dish, and it's the ultimate work of art, the result of the passion of a snowy country. This is the pinnacle of Japan's staple food.
product_fr:
Koshihikari de Minamiuonuma (district de Shiozawa, riz spécialement cultivé)
Le Koshihikari est produit dans la région de Shiozawa, considérée comme la meilleure productrice de riz du Japon. L’eau pure de fonte des neiges provoquée par les fortes chutes de neige et la différence de température drastique créent une douceur et un caractère collant écrasants dans chaque grain. L'éclat du riz fraîchement cuit est comme des perles. La saveur du riz est si forte qu'il n'est même pas nécessaire de l'accompagner, et c'est l'œuvre d'art ultime, le résultat de la passion d'un pays enneigé. C'est le summum de l'aliment de base du Japon.
product_tw:
南魚沼市越光（鹽澤地區，特產稻米）
越光產於鹽澤地區，據說這裡是日本最好的米生產地。大雪帶來的純淨雪水和劇烈的溫差，讓每一粒穀物都具有壓倒性的甜味和黏稠感。剛煮好的米飯光澤如珍珠。米飯的味道如此濃鬱，甚至不需要配菜，這是終極的藝術品，是雪國熱情的成果。這是日本主食的巔峰之作。

text_en:
Output text:

Gala Yuzawa. This is a modern-day station where the Joetsu Shinkansen is extended slightly from Echigo-Yuzawa for the winter only, providing skiers with direct access to the slopes. However, deep down in the glamor of the resort implied in the station's name, there is a strong sense of the longing for leisure that Japanese people had during the Showa era. After passing through the snowy Echigo mountains and passing through the Kanetsu Tunnel, you will find a world of pure white. This area, where the Shinkansen takes you directly to the slopes, pursues the latest technology and efficiency, and is filled with a mysterious charm that gives you a glimpse of the harshness of an area that experiences heavy snowfall, as well as the warmth of the lives of the people there. Amidst the bustle of winter, the travel spirit carried by trains is certainly alive and well.

Urasa. This place, nestled in the deep snow of Niigata, has been a strategic hub for the Joetsu Shinkansen since before its opening, but it still has a strong impression of being a Shinkansen stop. This station, known as a ``political station,'' would not be possible without the efforts of the late Kakuei Tanaka, and it has the feel of an industrial heritage that still conveys the enthusiasm of Japan during its period of high economic growth.

Surrounding the station is an idyllic rural landscape that grows abundant crops, such as eight-colored watermelons, and transforms into a world of white in winter. Particularly in February, the ``Naked Oshiai Festival'' is held at Fukoji Temple, and the heroic sight of men competing for lit candles in the bitter cold gives us a strong sense of the folk spirituality of this area. This station, where the Shinkansen and conventional lines intersect, can be described as a crossroads, the gateway to Echigo's journey from past to present and into the future.
product_ja:
八海山 千年こうじや「甘酒」
銘酒「八海山」の蔵人が、極限まで磨いた麹だけで作ったノンアルコールの甘酒。砂糖を一切使わず、麹由来の自然な甘みが驚くほどクリアに広がります。浦佐の厳しい冬を越えるための知恵が詰まった、飲む点滴。冷やして良し、温めて良し。八海山の清らかな伏流水を感じさせる、透き通った味わいは、まさに飲む「雪解け水」です。
product_en:
Hakkaisan Sennen Kojiya “Amazake”
A non-alcoholic amazake made by the brewer of the famous sake ``Hakkaisan'' using only koji that has been polished to the limit. No sugar is used, and the natural sweetness derived from koji spreads surprisingly clearly. A drinkable drip filled with wisdom to overcome Urasa's harsh winters. Good to chill or warm. The clear taste that reminds you of the clean underground water of Mt. Hakkaisan is just like drinking ``snowmelt water.''
product_fr:
Hakkaisan Sennen Kojiya « Amazake »
Un amazake sans alcool réalisé par le brasseur du célèbre saké « Hakkaisan » en utilisant uniquement du koji poli à l'extrême. Aucun sucre n'est utilisé et la douceur naturelle dérivée du koji se propage étonnamment clairement. Un goutte-à-goutte buvable rempli de sagesse pour surmonter les hivers rigoureux d'Urasa. Bon à rafraîchir ou à réchauffer. Le goût clair qui vous rappelle l'eau souterraine propre du mont Hakkaisan est comparable à celui de boire de « l'eau de fonte des neiges ».
product_tw:
八海山千年小地屋“甘酒”
由著名清酒「八海山」的釀酒廠僅使用精製的曲釀造而成的無酒精甘酒。不使用糖，來自曲的天然甜味令人驚訝地清晰地傳播。充滿智慧的飲用滴水，可以克服浦佐的嚴冬。適合寒冷或溫暖。清澈的味道讓人想起八海山乾淨的地下水，就像喝「融雪水」一樣。

text_en:
Yodo line. This railway, which runs from Kubokawa in Tosa to Uwajima in Iyo, is, as its name suggests, a guidepost that threads its way deep into the Shikoku Mountains, connecting ``Yo (Iyo)'' and ``Toshi (Tosa).'' Although it originally started life as a light railway on the Uwajima side, it was completed in 1960, making it the last of the Japanese National Railways' local lines to be completed, making it something of a latecomer.

Once the train passes through the shared section with the Tosa Kuroshio Railway and heads west from Wakai, a luxurious time awaits as you snuggle up to the meandering Shimanto River, ``Japan's last clear stream.'' The simple appearance of a submerged bridge flowing through the train window and the appearance of an unmanned station surrounded by deep greenery will make you forget the hustle and bustle of a city that values ​​efficiency, and remind you of the ``comfort'' that railways originally had. It may not be glamorous, but the journey, where the sound of the rails and the murmuring of the river resonate, is a valuable legacy that conveys the pure emotion of Showa era rail travel. The sight of unique Shinkansen-style vehicles and trolley trains made from converted freight cars running through the mountains shows the warm passion of the people who love this railway and want to protect it.

text_en: Kubokawa Station. Located in the southwestern part of Kochi Prefecture, this station is the terminus of the Dosan Line and the starting point of the Tosa Kuroshio Railway Nakamura Line, and is truly a key railway hub and a gateway for travelers. Since its opening in the early Showa era, countless trains have passed through this area, and even though it changed form into the third sector in the Heisei era, it has continued to hold on to the dream of a line that continues to the Pacific Ocean. Upon landing at the platform, travelers are enveloped in a clean air that makes them feel the majesty of the Shimanto River flowing in the distance, and their hearts are filled with anticipation for the next adventure and nostalgia for the past. The station building is lined with shops selling locally produced ingredients, and although it is a small station, it conveys the vibrancy of the area. This is a rare space where the history of railways and the joy of traveling towards the future are condensed.

product_ja:
四万十ポーク 桜味噌漬け
予土線の起点、窪川。ここで育つ「四万十ポーク」は、四万十川の清流と豊かな自然の中で、芋を食べて育つ贅沢な豚です。その身は驚くほど白く、脂身の甘みが格別。特製の桜味噌に漬け込まれた肉を焼けば、香ばしい香りが鼻をくすぐり、口の中で肉汁がじゅわっと溢れ出します。四万十の滋味をそのまま凝縮したような、力強い味わいです。
product_en:
Shimanto Pork Pickled in Sakura Miso
Kubokawa, the starting point of the Yodo Line. The "Shimanto Pork" that is grown here is a luxurious pig that is raised on a diet of potatoes in the clear waters of the Shimanto River and in the rich nature. The flesh is surprisingly white, and the sweetness of the fat is exceptional. When you grill the meat marinated in the special cherry blossom miso, the fragrant aroma tickles your nose and the meat juices overflow in your mouth. It has a powerful taste that seems to have concentrated the flavor of Shimanto.
product_fr:
Porc Shimanto mariné au Sakura Miso
Kubokawa, point de départ de la ligne Yodo. Le « porc Shimanto » cultivé ici est un porc luxueux élevé avec un régime de pommes de terre dans les eaux claires de la rivière Shimanto et dans la riche nature. La chair est étonnamment blanche et la douceur du gras est exceptionnelle. Lorsque vous faites griller la viande marinée dans le miso spécial aux fleurs de cerisier, l'arôme parfumé vous chatouille le nez et le jus de viande déborde dans votre bouche. Il a un goût puissant qui semble avoir concentré la saveur du Shimanto.
product_tw:
櫻花味噌四萬十豬肉
窪川，淀線的起點。這裡種植的「四萬十豬肉」是在四萬十川的清澈水域和豐富的大自然中以馬鈴薯為食飼養的名貴豬。果肉出奇的白，脂肪的甜味也異常鮮美。當您燒烤用特製櫻花味噌醃製的肉時，香氣撲鼻，肉汁溢滿口腔。味道濃鬱，似乎濃縮了四萬十的味道。

text_en:
Wakai. Away from the urban area of ​​Kubokawa, it stands in the mountains overlooking the clear waters of the Shimanto River, serving as a practical turning point where the fates of the Yodo Line and the Nakamura Line diverge. This small station, which was founded in 1966 with the opening of the National Railways Nakamura Line, does not have an ornate station building, but it exudes a quiet atmosphere as a ``node of travel'' where two railway lines intersect.

When you arrive at the platform, the slow flow of the Shimanto River, the last clear stream, spreads out below you, and the wind blowing across the river carries the scent of Tosa's mountains. Fireflies dance in the neighborhood in early summer, and autumn leaves decorate the railroad tracks in autumn. Its tranquil appearance gives the impression that it has preserved the original scenery of good old Japan, as if it had been cut off from the modern railway network that emphasizes efficiency.

The Yodo Line runs from here to Uwajima in Ehime, or the Nakamura Line heads for Sukumo. No matter which train you wait for, a moment at this unmanned station with the breeze blowing through it has a mysterious magical power that makes you reaffirm the purpose of your journey. More than just a passing point, this small platform is filled with the sense of solitude and exhilaration that is unique to places where railways intersect.
