text_en:
Yasu. Located on the coastline of Konan City, it is one of the brightest stations on the Gomen-Nahari Line and is filled with the openness of a tropical country. Once upon a time, the Tosa Electric Railway's Aki Line ran leisurely through this area, but in 2002, the railway was revived as a magnificent elevated line.The history of this area gives us a sense of the tenacious vitality of the railway.

Looking down from the platform, travelers are greeted by the white sands of Ya-Shi Park, one of the prefecture's leading beaches, and the endless blue horizon of Tosa Bay. If you walk a short distance from the station, you will see a rare structure called a movable hand-tied bridge looking up at the sky like a giant gate, giving you a sense of the wisdom and history of the Tosa Sea People.

The station character ``Yasu Yasuda-kun'' smiles in a swimsuit, as a diesel train breezes by, blowing the sea breeze. Here, you can experience a rich time unique to Tosa, where the travel spirit of the Showa era and the modern resort feel are exquisitely blended.
product_ja:
エメラルドメロン
太平洋を望む温室で、一株に一玉だけを慈しんで育て上げる「エメラルドメロン」。その名の通り、エメラルドのように美しい果肉と、麝香（ムスク）のような芳醇な香りは、まさにメロンの王様です。とろけるような口当たりと、喉の奥まで残る上品な甘さ。特別な日のデザートに、大切な方への贈り物に、夜須の潮風と太陽が作り上げた至宝をぜひ。
product_en:
emerald melon
Emerald melons are grown in a greenhouse overlooking the Pacific Ocean, with only one melon per plant. As its name suggests, it is the king of melons, with beautiful emerald-like flesh and a rich musk-like aroma. It has a melt-in-the-mouth texture and an elegant sweetness that lingers deep in your throat. Whether it's a dessert for a special day or a gift for a loved one, try this treasure created by Yasu's sea breeze and sun.
product_fr:
melon émeraude
Les melons émeraude sont cultivés dans une serre surplombant l’océan Pacifique, avec un seul melon par plante. Comme son nom l'indique, c'est le roi des melons, avec une belle chair émeraude et un riche arôme de musc. Il a une texture fondante et une douceur élégante qui persiste au fond de la gorge. Qu'il s'agisse d'un dessert pour un jour spécial ou d'un cadeau pour un être cher, essayez ce trésor créé par la brise marine et le soleil de Yasu.
product_tw:
翡翠瓜
翡翠瓜種植在俯瞰太平洋的溫室中，每株只種植一個瓜。顧名思義，它是瓜中之王，果肉美麗如翡翠，香氣濃鬱如麝香。入口即化的口感和優雅的甜味在喉嚨深處縈繞。無論是特殊日子的甜點還是送給心愛之人的禮物，都可以嘗試雅蘇海風和陽光創造的這件珍寶。

text_en:
Western part. At the western end of Geisei Village, this modern elevated station stands amidst a sea of ​​neatly lined plastic greenhouses, with the sound of the Pacific Ocean in the background. The fact that this new railway, revived in 2002, has firmly inherited the memory of the station as a stop on the Tosa Electric Railway Aki Line, which was abolished in 1960, is deeply moving even for non-railway fans.

When you land on the platform, the waves of the house reflecting Tosa's intense sunlight and the deep blue of Tosa Bay on the other side create a wonderful contrast. This is a land where greenhouse horticulture is popular, taking advantage of the warm climate even in winter, and the strong efforts of the local community can be felt through the sound of the rails.

The station character ``Nishibun Tsuki-chan'' greets you with an adorable figure reminiscent of the moon rising over Kotogahama, giving you a sense of the poetic spirit that lives here. In the silence after the only diesel car has left, looking at the horizon while being blown by the sea breeze, you will feel that time is passing slowly but surely, just like in those days of the Showa era.

Japanese food (wajiki). Travelers can't help but smile at the unusual yet appetizing sound of the station name. This station, located almost in the center of Geisei Village, has a history as a stop on the Tosa Electric Railway Aki Line, which was abolished in 1960, and in 2002 it regained the heartbeat of the railway.

When you land on the platform, you will see waves of plastic greenhouses, the core industry of Geisei Village, waving below you, and beyond that the magnificent Pacific Ocean and the pine forest of Kotogahama. This area is also known as a production area for melons and flowers that have been exposed to the Tosa sun, and even though it is a modern elevated station, the atmosphere is filled with the calmness typical of a rural village.

The station character, ``Wajiki Kappa-kun,'' shows off his charm as a diesel car lightly moves away. This railway, which uses the latest technology to revive the memories of daily life etched by the old Aki Line, quietly teaches us, under the Reiwa sky, the preciousness of being together with the community even as times change.

Akano. Located on the western edge of Aki City, on the border with Geisei Village, it is a truly refreshing elevated station with a magnificent view of the Pacific Ocean. The history of how the railway was rebuilt in the Heisei era, tracing the roadbed of the Tosa Electric Railway's Aki Line, which was once decommissioned in 1960, gives us a sense of the tenacity of the people who tried to support transportation in this area.

When you arrive at the platform, you can see the beautiful pine forest of Kotogahama Beach washed by the Kuroshio Current and the endless white sandy beach, and the sound of the waves rolling in and out creates a soothing rhythm. The sight of the station character, ``Aka no Kamome-chan,'' greeting travelers while being blown by the sea breeze, reminds us that this is truly a ``sea station.''

Although there is no flashy station building, the light joint sounds of the diesel cars and the gradation of blue that blends the sky and sea are enough to make you feel the luxury of a journey. The contrast between the idyllic atmosphere reminiscent of the old Aki Line era and the modern elevated structure quietly tells the story of the long history of Tosa's railways.

Inside the hole (anainai). The station is located on the western edge of Aki City, where the blue expanse of the Pacific Ocean can be seen on the left, and trains traveling on a powerful elevated line approach a sea of ​​plastic greenhouses as far as the eye can see. In the past, the Tosa Electric Railway Aki Line ran through this area, supporting people's lives, but after its unfortunate abolition in 1960, it made a dramatic comeback as the Three-Second Railway in 2002, making it a place that truly symbolizes the unyielding history of railways.

When you arrive at the platform, a warm earthy scent wafts through the sea breeze. This is the production area of ​​``Tosa eggplant,'' which is famous nationwide. The cluster of greenhouses stretching as far as the eye can see is bathed in the Tosa sun even during the harsh winters, giving you a sense of the strong heartbeat that supports the local economy. The station character, ``Anauchi Nasubi-san,'' welcomes travelers with a slightly absent-minded expression, giving us a sense of the relaxed spirit and playfulness of the local people.

Although it is a modern elevated structure, the view of the Pacific Ocean at dusk from the platform retains the ``tranquility beyond the train window'' that Shunzo Miyawaki loved. If you listen to the sound of the waves and insects with the sound of the passing trains in the background, you will see that the original scenery of Tosa, which has remained unchanged even though times have changed, is still alive here.

In front of the stadium. As the name suggests, it is a rare place that speaks so eloquently about the existence of the Aki Municipal Baseball Stadium, which stretches out in front of the station. Once known as the Japan National Railways Asa Line, when the dream of the Showa era was dormant with only the concrete piers remaining, only buses ran through this area, but when it opened in 2002, it took on the mission of being a railway that transported enthusiastic fans heading to the Hanshin Tigers' campsite.

When you step onto the elevated platform, the damp sea breeze caresses the white roof of Aki Dome, reflecting the Tosa sunlight and making it shine brightly. The excitement of the Aki camp, where famous Showa players such as Minoru Murayama and Koichi Tabuchi sweated out, is still alive today as a pride of this town, and just looking at the stadium from the home makes you feel nostalgic for the Japanese people who love baseball.

In recent years, the campground of the first team has changed, but during fall camps and farm games, "Tiger Party" still gathers from all over the country, and the unmanned station is filled with temporary liveliness. The sight of the station character, ``Kyujo-kun,'' holding a bat is reminiscent of the brave images of the fierce tigers of the past, and it lights up a small sense of elation in the hearts of travelers. Against the backdrop of the blue Pacific Ocean, the dreams of the men who chased the white ball and the tenacity of the people who connected the railroads are quietly intersecting on this wind-blown elevated platform.

In front of Aki General Hospital. It is the freshest stop on the Gomen-Nahari Line, carved into the railway as a new light of hope in Reiwa 3, transcending the Heisei era. In the Showa era, when the National Railways Asa Line was once a dream, no one could have predicted that a station would be located here, but its appearance, which was born in response to the relocation of the prefectural hospital that supports local medical care, reminds us that the railway is more than just a means of transportation, it is a ``way of life.''

When you get off the elevated platform, you will be greeted by a modern hospital building and the ``Aki General Hospital Nasu-chan'' modeled after Aki's specialty, eggplant, dressed as a nurse. The scent of the sea carried by the sea breeze and the whiteness of the clean medical facility create a unique atmosphere that gives you a unique atmosphere at this station.

Cutting-edge medical care and the leisurely rhythm of a single diesel train. The scene created by this contrast loudly proclaims under the Reiwa sky the unchanging essence of railways remaining close to the lives of local people, even as times change and convenience is pursued.

Aki. This station, which plays the core of the Gomen-Nahari Line, was born on the historical site where the Tosa Electric Railway Aki Line once flourished, restoring the pride of the railway once again. In the Showa era, when the dream of the National Railways Asa Line was about to collapse due to financial difficulties, the huge viaduct that ran through the town was sometimes ridiculed as the ``grave marker of the railroad'', but with its opening in 2002, it has now returned to being an imposing strategic point that supports Aki County's economy and transportation.

When you arrive at the platform, you will find yourself in the indomitable town where Yataro Iwasaki, the founder of the Mitsubishi zaibatsu, was born and raised. It makes you feel that Yataro's dream of ``the rise of a country from the sea'' still pervades every corner of the city along with the sea breeze. The headquarters of the Tosa Kuroshio Railway is located in the station building, and the sight of only one diesel car being replaced in a hurry is a testament to the powerful pulse of the local private railway.

If you are drawn to the fragrant smell of the famous ``Kamaage Chirimen'' and take a short trip to look at the ``Nara Clock'', you will feel that even the time is passing slowly, just like that day in the Showa era. When you climb back up to the elevated platform with the Pacific Ocean in your back, you can feel that the railway is melting into the dusk and lies there as a sure bridge to tomorrow.
product_ja:
安芸特産 柚子（ゆず）ドリンク「ゆずの村」
安芸の山々を黄金色に染める柚子の香り。ここで作られる「馬路村」や安芸周辺の柚子製品は、酸味の「キレ」が違います。お取り寄せで人気のジュースやポン酢は、ひと口飲めば鼻から突き抜ける鮮烈な香りが特徴。特に完熟柚子を贅沢に使ったシロップは、炭酸で割れば土佐の夏空のように爽やかな一杯に。安芸の自然が凝縮された、元気の出る逸品です。
product_en:
Aki specialty yuzu drink “Yuzu no Mura”
The scent of yuzu paints the mountains of Aki golden yellow. The yuzu products made here from Umaji Village and around Aki have a different sourness. The juices and ponzu sauce that are popular on order have a distinctive aroma that pierces through your nose as soon as you take a sip. In particular, the syrup is made with plenty of ripe yuzu, and when mixed with carbonated water, it becomes a refreshing drink like the summer sky of Tosa. A revitalizing gem that is a condensation of Aki's nature.
product_fr:
Boisson au yuzu spécialité Aki « Yuzu no Mura »
Le parfum du yuzu peint les montagnes d'Aki en jaune doré. Les produits au yuzu fabriqués ici dans le village d'Umaji et autour d'Aki ont une acidité différente. Les jus et la sauce ponzu très appréciés sur commande ont un arôme distinctif qui vous transperce le nez dès que vous en prenez une gorgée. En particulier, le sirop est composé de beaucoup de yuzu mûr et, mélangé à de l'eau gazeuse, il devient une boisson rafraîchissante comme le ciel d'été de Tosa. Un joyau revitalisant qui est un condensé de la nature d'Aki.
product_tw:
安藝名產柚子飲料“柚子之村”
柚子的香氣將安藝的山巒染成了金黃色。馬路村和安藝週邊生產的柚子產品有不同的酸味。點單時很受歡迎的果汁和柳橙醬，喝一口就會有一股獨特的香氣撲鼻而來。特別是，糖漿是用大量成熟的柚子製成的，與碳酸水混合後，就變成了土佐夏日天空般的清涼飲料。凝結了阿藝本質的煥發寶石。

text_en:
Ioki. Located to the east of Aki City, the elevated station is located along the coastline washed by the rough waves of the Pacific Ocean. The once grand dream of the Asa Line, once on the brink of extinction during the turbulence of the Showa era, came to fruition in the Heisei era as the third sector, which truly symbolizes the indomitable spirit of the people of Tosa.

If you walk for just a few minutes from the station, you will find Iogi Cave, a beautiful natural structure created over tens of thousands of years, quietly opening its mouth. Once you step inside, you will feel like you are in an ancient forest. Rare ferns that have been designated as national natural monuments grow here, and the sound of dripping water and the cool breeze will make your trip even more memorable.

If you look up at the charming figure of ``Ioki Torataro-kun'' who protects the station and go up to the elevated platform again, you will see a blue horizon that stretches out forever. In this place where the everyday and the mysterious exist side by side, the time spent waiting for the train to arrive while being blown by the sea breeze helps us regain the peace of mind that we have lost in our efficient society.

Down the mountain. Located on the eastern edge of Aki City, this station stands quietly on an elevated railway line overlooking the Pacific Ocean, and today, in the Reiwa era, it conveys fragments of the magnificent story known as the Asa Line, which was once a dream of the Japanese National Railways. Although construction began in the 1960s, construction was halted due to the turbulent waves of the times, and for a long time only the concrete remains were left exposed to the sea breeze.The opening in 2002 was the culmination of that dedication.

When you arrive at the platform, the mighty white waves of the Pacific Ocean crash below you, and the scent of the ocean coming through the pine forest gently tickles your nostrils. The station character ``Shimoyama Chidori-chan'' greets you with a cute, non-staggering appearance that gives you a sense of the brightness and playfulness of the Tosa people when it comes to travel.

In spring, camellias bloom in the nearby Shimoyama Park, adding vibrant color to the otherwise inorganic elevated station. Although it is not a flashy tourist destination, the sound of the sea, the sound of the trains, and the endless horizon will remind you of the real thrill of traveling on the farthest railway line.

Karahama. Located on the western edge of Yasuda Town, on a powerful elevated railway line where you can hear the sound of the Pacific Ocean through the pine forest, this station is a nexus where history and faith intersect on the southwestern tip of Shikoku. The construction of the Asa Line, which was once part of the National Railways Asa Line, began in the Showa era, but for a long time it was abandoned as an "unfinished railway" with no trains running through it, and the concrete remains were finally brought back to life in 2002.

As soon as you get off the platform, right behind you is Kōneji Temple, the 27th sacred temple in Shikoku, which is known for its steep pilgrimage route called ``Matate'', giving you a sense of the unique Tosa atmosphere where ancient pilgrimage routes and modern railways coexist. The station character ``Tohama Henro-kun'' welcomes you in a sedge hat, giving you a strong sense that this place is still part of the path of prayer. The waves of plastic greenhouses that spread around the area tell the story of the region's strong efforts, and the scent of earth carried on the sea breeze will deepen your travel experience.

Yasuda. Proceeding east on the elevated Gomen Nahari Line, this is a truly atmospheric stop located at the foot of the clear stream of the Yasuda River flowing into the Pacific Ocean. The fact that the viaduct, which was once dreamed of as part of the National Railways Asa Line in the Showa era and left unfinished for a long time, has finally regained its iron sound in the Heisei era makes us feel the fruition of obsession in railway history.

When you get off the platform, you can see the clear waters of the Yasuda River, which is famous nationwide as the ``river where sweetfish dance'', and the atmospheric townscape where long-established sake breweries stand quietly, giving you a strong sense of the traditional atmosphere of Tosa. Yasuda is blessed with abundant water that nurtures the famous sakes ``Minami'' and ``Tamanoi,'' and retains traces of its history as a thriving distribution center for timber transported by the forest railway.

The horizon of the Pacific Ocean seen from the elevated track conveys the excitement of the era when the dream of railways continued to Muroto under the Reiwa sky. The smiling face of Ayunari Yasuda, who protects the station, also symbolizes the indomitable spirit of this place to move forward with the railway.

Tano. In this town, which is the smallest in Shikoku and is known as one of Japan's "small but spicy" municipalities, there is a magnificent elevated station on the Gomen-Nahari Line. Every time I come here, I feel the weight of history, as the elevated bridge, which began construction in the Showa era as part of the National Railways Asa Line, was abandoned as an "unfinished railway" for a long time, but finally came back to life in 2002.

There are roadside stations right next to the station, and the mellow scent of ``salt salt'' made only by Tosa's sun and wind tickles the nostrils of travelers. It was once the place where 23 samurai ran through the turmoil of the end of the Edo period, fearing for their country, and this historical background gives it a dignified air throughout the compact townscape.

If you stand on the elevated platform and look out at the clear waters of the Nahari River and the blue Pacific Ocean beyond, you will notice that the modern concrete structure and the good old Tosa climate are in perfect harmony. This station, where express trains also stop, is not just a transit point, but its appearance gives us a sense of its pride as an economic and cultural nexus that supports the eastern part of Aki District.
product_ja:
田野屋塩二郎「完全天日塩」
「日本一小さな町」田野で作られる、日本一贅沢な塩。火を一切使わず、手作業で数ヶ月かけて結晶させる「田野屋塩二郎」の塩は、ミネラルの複雑な旨味が舌の上で爆発します。大粒の結晶をパラリと肉に載せるだけで、素材の味が劇的に変化。もはや調味料という枠を超えた、太平洋の波音と太陽の光が形を成したような、奇跡の「海の結晶」です。
product_en:
Tanoya Shiojiro “Completely sun-dried salt”
Japan's most luxurious salt made in Tano, ``Japan's smallest town.'' Tanoya Shiojiro's salt is crystallized by hand over several months without using any fire, and the complex mineral flavor explodes on your tongue. Just by placing large crystals on meat, the taste of the material changes dramatically. More than just a seasoning, it is a miraculous ``sea crystal'' that resembles the sound of waves in the Pacific Ocean and the light of the sun.
product_fr:
Tanoya Shiojiro « Sel entièrement séché au soleil »
Le sel le plus luxueux du Japon est fabriqué à Tano, « la plus petite ville du Japon ». Le sel de Tanoya Shiojiro est cristallisé à la main pendant plusieurs mois sans utiliser de feu, et la saveur minérale complexe explose sur votre langue. En plaçant simplement de gros cristaux sur la viande, le goût du matériau change radicalement. Plus qu'un simple assaisonnement, c'est un « cristal de mer » miraculeux qui ressemble au bruit des vagues de l'océan Pacifique et à la lumière du soleil.
product_tw:
田野屋鹽二郎“完全曬乾的鹽”
日本最奢華的鹽產自「日本最小的城鎮」田野。田野屋鹽二郎的鹽是在不使用任何火的情況下，經過數月的手工結晶而成的，複雜的礦物風味在您的舌尖爆發。只要將大晶體放在肉上，材料的味道就會產生巨大的變化。它不僅僅是一種調味料，更是一種神奇的“海水晶”，類似於太平洋的海浪聲和太陽的光。

text_en:
Nahari. It is the eastern dead end and terminal station of the Asa Line, which runs along a powerful elevated line from Gomen, overlooking the rough waves of Tosa Bay on the right. The grand plan of the Asa Line, once dreamed of by Japan National Railways to circumnavigate the east coast of Shikoku by rail, was born in the 1960s, but it was once frozen due to financial difficulties, but it was revived in 2002 as a third sector line.

Once you step off the elevated platform, the sea breeze from the Pacific Ocean blowing in from the mouth of the Nahari River brings back memories of one of Japan's leading forest railways that once transported high-quality timber from the deep mountains of Yanase, giving you a sense of emotion that is appropriate for the end of your journey. On the first floor of the station, the aroma of boiled ``Kinmedai'' and yuzu citrus beckons travelers, and the local life and pride are clearly in the air. If you look up at the unfinished sky beyond the parking lot that was supposed to lead to Muroto, it will quietly tell you that the dream of the railway is not yet over.
product_ja:
土佐の「米豚（こめぶた）」
ごめん・なはり線の終着点。ここで育つ「米豚」は、その名の通り高知県産の米を食べて育ちます。その恩恵は脂の「白さ」と「甘さ」に現れ、豚肉特有の臭みが全くありません。厚切りのロースをソテーすれば、驚くほどジューシーで、お米由来の上質な甘みが口いっぱいに広がります。山と海が迫る奈半利の豊かな環境が育んだ、力強い畜産の傑作です。
product_en:
Tosa's "Komebuta"
The terminal point of the Gomen Nahari Line. As the name suggests, the rice pigs grown here eat rice grown in Kochi Prefecture. The benefits of this are evident in the whiteness and sweetness of the fat, and there is no odor typical of pork. If you saute the thickly sliced ​​loin, it will be surprisingly juicy, and the high-quality sweetness from the rice will fill your mouth. This is a masterpiece of powerful livestock farming, nurtured by the rich environment of Nahari, where the mountains and sea are close.
product_fr:
Le "Komebuta" de Tosa
Le point terminal de la ligne Gomen Nahari. Comme son nom l'indique, les porcs de riz élevés ici mangent du riz cultivé dans la préfecture de Kochi. Les avantages sont évidents dans la blancheur et la douceur de la graisse, et il n'y a pas d'odeur typique du porc. Si vous faites sauter la longe en tranches épaisses, elle sera étonnamment juteuse et la douceur de haute qualité du riz remplira votre bouche. Il s'agit d'un chef-d'œuvre d'un élevage puissant, nourri par l'environnement riche du Nahari, où les montagnes et la mer sont proches.
product_tw:
土佐的“米豬”
後免奈半利線的終點站。顧名思義，這裡飼養的稻豬吃的是高知縣種的稻米。這樣做的好處是脂肪的潔白和甜味，並且沒有豬肉特有的氣味。如果將厚切的里肌肉炒一下，它會出乎意料地多汁，米飯的優質甜味會填滿你的嘴。這是依山傍海的納哈里豐富的環境孕育出的強大畜牧業的傑作。

product_ja:
浅草今半 牛肉重（牛肉佃煮詰め合わせ）
明治28年創業、浅草の粋を今に伝える「今半」の牛肉佃煮。厳選された黒毛和牛を、秘伝の割り下でじっくりと炊き上げた逸品です。口の中で解ける肉の繊維から、濃厚な旨味と醤油の芳醇な香りが溢れ出します。温かいご飯に載せた瞬間に立ち昇る香りは、江戸の情緒そのもの。これぞ、日本の中心・東京が誇る至高の贅沢です。
product_en:
Asakusa Imahan Beef Ju (assorted beef tsukudani)
Imahan's beef tsukudani, founded in 1890, continues to convey the essence of Asakusa. This is a masterpiece made with carefully selected Kuroge Wagyu beef carefully cooked using a secret method. The rich flavor and rich aroma of soy sauce overflows from the fibers of the meat that melt in your mouth. The aroma that rises the moment you put it on hot rice is the very atmosphere of Edo. This is the ultimate luxury that Tokyo, the center of Japan, is proud of.
product_fr:
Asakusa Imahan Beef Ju (assortiment de tsukudani de bœuf)
Le tsukudani de bœuf d'Imahan, fondé en 1890, continue de transmettre l'essence d'Asakusa. Il s'agit d'un chef-d'œuvre à base de bœuf Kuroge Wagyu soigneusement sélectionné, soigneusement cuit selon une méthode secrète. La riche saveur et le riche arôme de la sauce soja débordent des fibres de la viande qui fondent dans la bouche. L'arôme qui monte au moment où vous le mettez sur du riz chaud est l'atmosphère même d'Edo. C'est le luxe ultime dont Tokyo, le centre du Japon, est fière.
product_tw:
淺草今半牛肉居（什錦牛肉佃煮）
今半的牛肉佃煮創立於 1890 年，繼續傳達淺草的精髓。這是嚴選黑毛和牛，採用秘法精心烹調而成的傑作。醬油的濃鬱風味和濃郁香氣從肉的纖維溢出，在口中融化。放在熱飯上的那一剎那，香氣撲鼻而來，這就是江戶的風情。這就是日本中心東京引以自豪的極致奢華。

text_en: Shinagawa. In ancient times, it flourished as the number one post town on the Tokaido route, and today it has become a strategic location with many high-rise buildings. From the days when steam locomotives spewed smoke, the station is now undergoing a transformation into the starting station for the Linear Chuo Shinkansen, giving us a sense of how times have changed. Even in the midst of the hustle and bustle of the city, the humid wind that is characteristic of areas near the sea blows through.

product_ja:
坂角総本舖 ゆかり（海老せんべい）
品川駅の定番であり、江戸時代からの製法を守る黄金の海老せんべい。1枚に約7尾もの天然海老を贅沢に使用し、鉄板で焼き上げた後に炭火でじっくり二度焼き。バリッとした力強い歯ごたえと共に、海老の濃厚な旨味と香ばしさが爆発します。品川の海を往来した歴史に思いを馳せながら、濃い目のお茶と共に楽しみたい逸品です。
product_en:
Sakakaku Sohonbo Yukari (shrimp rice crackers)
Golden shrimp rice crackers are a staple at Shinagawa Station and are made using a manufacturing method dating back to the Edo period. Each piece uses a generous amount of about 7 natural shrimp, grilled on an iron plate and then slowly grilled over charcoal twice. Along with the crunchy and strong texture, the rich flavor and aroma of the shrimp explodes. This is a masterpiece that you can enjoy with a cup of strong tea while thinking about the history of people traveling to and from the sea in Shinagawa.
product_fr:
Sakakaku Sohonbo Yukari (craquelins de riz aux crevettes)
Les craquelins de riz aux crevettes dorées sont un aliment de base à la gare de Shinagawa et sont fabriqués selon une méthode de fabrication remontant à la période Edo. Chaque morceau utilise une quantité généreuse d'environ 7 crevettes naturelles, grillées sur une plaque de fer puis lentement grillées deux fois sur du charbon de bois. En plus de la texture croquante et forte, la riche saveur et l'arôme des crevettes explosent. C'est un chef-d'œuvre que vous pouvez déguster avec une tasse de thé fort tout en pensant à l'histoire des personnes voyageant vers et depuis la mer à Shinagawa.
product_tw:
Sakakaku Sohonbo Yukari（蝦米果）
金蝦米果是品川站的主食，其製作方法可追溯到江戶時代。每片均使用大量約7隻天然蝦，放在鐵板上烤，然後在木炭上慢慢烤兩次。伴隨著鬆脆而濃鬱的口感，蝦子的濃鬱風味和香氣爆發出來。這是您可以一邊喝著濃茶，一邊思考品川海上往來的人們的歷史的傑作。

audio_ja: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saffron12safron-oss/rail-audio/main/audio/東海道新幹線_東海道新幹線_4_ja.mp3
text_en: Shin-Yokohama. The history of this area, which was once a rice field, transformed into the northern gateway to Yokohama with the opening of the Shinkansen is astounding. Here you can find a sophisticated urban landscape that is a little different from the atmosphere of the port. However, if you walk a little further, you will find a space like the Shin-Yokohama Ramen Museum, which is a recreation of a Showa alley, where the conveniences of civilization and nostalgia coexist.

product_ja:
崎陽軒 シウマイ（真空パック）
横浜の顔といえば、崎陽軒。豚肉と干帆立貝柱が出会って生まれた、あの独特のコクと旨味をお取り寄せで。冷めても美味しいよう計算されたレシピは、自宅で蒸し直すことで、さらにふっくらとした肉質と帆立の香りが際立ちます。一口サイズに凝縮された横浜の歴史とプライド。これを食べずして東海道は語れません。
product_en:
Kiyoken Shumai (vacuum pack)
Kiyoken is the face of Yokohama. Order the unique richness and flavor created by the combination of pork and dried scallops. The recipe is designed to be delicious even when it's cold, and by re-steaming it at home, you can make the meat even more plump and the aroma of the scallops stand out. Yokohama's history and pride condensed into bite-sized pieces. You can't talk about Tokaido without eating this.
product_fr:
Kiyoken Shumai (sous vide)
Kiyoken est le visage de Yokohama. Commandez la richesse et la saveur uniques créées par la combinaison du porc et des pétoncles séchés. La recette est conçue pour être délicieuse même froide, et en la recuisant à la vapeur à la maison, vous pourrez rendre la viande encore plus charnue et faire ressortir l'arôme des coquilles Saint-Jacques. L'histoire et la fierté de Yokohama sont condensées en petits morceaux. Vous ne pouvez pas parler du Tokaido sans manger ça.
product_tw:
Kiyoken Shumai（真空包裝）
Kiyoken是橫濱的面孔。點一份豬肉和乾貝組合所創造的獨特的濃鬱和風味。食譜設計的目的就是冷了也好吃，在家重新蒸一下，可以讓肉質更加肥美，扇貝的香氣更加突出。橫濱的歷史和自豪感濃縮成一口大小的碎片。不吃這個就不能談論東海道。

audio_ja: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saffron12safron-oss/rail-audio/main/audio/東海道新幹線_東海道新幹線_5_ja.mp3
text_en: Odawara. With the Hakone peak in the background, it still conveys the dignity of being a castle town of the Sengoku feudal lord, the Hojo clan. As you exit the station, the faint scent of the ocean tickles your nose, making you feel the rich blessings of Sagami Bay. Gazing at the Odawara lanterns and thinking about the history of travelers taking a break before crossing Hakone, railway travel becomes even more special.

product_ja:
鈴廣かまぼこ 特上蒲鉾（紅白）
箱根の天然水と、厳選されたグチなどの魚を使い、保存料を一切使わず作り上げる小田原の至宝。しなやかでプリッとした弾力は、まさに「魚の命」を噛みしめる感触です。噛むほどに魚の自然な甘みが広がり、後味は清々しい。板から剥がし、厚めに切ってわさび醤油で。城下町・小田原の品格を感じさせる、本物の味わいです。
product_en:
Suzuhiro Kamaboko Special Kamaboko (red and white)
This treasure of Odawara is made using Hakone's natural water and carefully selected fish such as croaker, without using any preservatives. The supple and firm texture feels like savoring the life of a fish. The more you chew, the more the natural sweetness of the fish spreads, and the aftertaste is refreshing. Peel it off the board, cut it into thick pieces, and season it with wasabi and soy sauce. It has an authentic taste that makes you feel the dignity of the castle town of Odawara.
product_fr:
Suzuhiro Kamaboko Spécial Kamaboko (rouge et blanc)
Ce trésor d'Odawara est fabriqué à partir de l'eau naturelle de Hakone et de poissons soigneusement sélectionnés comme le courbine, sans utiliser aucun conservateur. La texture souple et ferme donne l'impression de savourer la vie d'un poisson. Plus vous mâchez, plus la douceur naturelle du poisson se propage et l'arrière-goût est rafraîchissant. Décollez-le de la planche, coupez-le en morceaux épais et assaisonnez-le de wasabi et de sauce soja. Il a un goût authentique qui vous fait ressentir la dignité de la ville-château d'Odawara.
product_tw:
鈴弘魚糕特製魚糕（紅、白）
這是小田原的瑰寶，使用箱根的天然水和嚴格挑選的黃花魚等魚類製成，不使用任何防腐劑。柔軟緊實的質感，讓人感覺像是在品味魚的生命。越嚼，魚的自然甜味越擴散，餘韻清爽。將其從板上剝下來，切成厚片，用芥末和醬油調味。其味道純正，讓人感受到小田原城下町的尊嚴。

audio_ja: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saffron12safron-oss/rail-audio/main/audio/東海道新幹線_東海道新幹線_6_ja.mp3
text_en: Atami. As you pass through the tunnel, you'll suddenly see the blue ocean and an inn town that clings to the slope. It has a style that can be called the classic tourist destination of the Showa era. Famous inns loved by great writers and Hatsushima Island visible beyond the steam. The relaxing atmosphere unique to hot spring towns that envelopes you the moment you step off the Shinkansen provides a rest for busy modern people.

product_ja:
熱海 釜鶴の干物セット
熱海の潮風を浴びて熟成された、江戸時代から続く老舗「釜鶴」の干物。近海で獲れた金目鯛や鯵を、秘伝の塩汁に漬け込み、職人が一枚ずつ手開きしています。焼けば皮はパリッと、身はじゅわっと脂が溢れ出し、凝縮された海の旨味が口いっぱいに広がります。温泉街の朝を自宅で再現する、これ以上ない贅沢な目覚めの一品です。
product_en:
Atami Kamazuru dried fish set
Dried fish from Kamazuru, a long-established restaurant that has been around since the Edo period, is aged in the sea breeze of Atami. Golden sea bream and horse mackerel caught in nearby waters are marinated in a secret salt soup and then hand-opened one by one by our craftsmen. When grilled, the skin becomes crispy, the meat overflows with fat, and the concentrated flavor of the sea spreads throughout your mouth. This is a luxurious wake-up dish that recreates the morning experience of a hot spring town at home.
product_fr:
Ensemble de poisson séché Atami Kamazuru
Le poisson séché de Kamazuru, un restaurant établi de longue date depuis la période Edo, est vieilli dans la brise marine d'Atami. Daurades dorées et chinchards pêchés dans les eaux voisines sont marinés dans une soupe salée secrète puis ouverts un à un à la main par nos artisans. Lorsqu'elle est grillée, la peau devient croustillante, la viande déborde de gras et la saveur concentrée de la mer se répand dans toute la bouche. Il s’agit d’un plat de réveil luxueux qui recrée à la maison l’expérience matinale d’une ville thermale.
product_tw:
熱海鐮鶴魚乾套餐
從江戶時代就開始營業的老字號鐮鶴的乾魚，是在熱海的海風中熟成的。將附近水域捕獲的黃金鯛魚和竹莢魚用秘製鹽湯醃製，然後由我們的工匠將它們一一手工打開。烤的時候，外皮酥脆，肉質溢出，濃濃的海味在口中蔓延。這是一款豪華的起床菜餚，在家中重現溫泉小鎮的早晨體驗。

audio_ja: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saffron12safron-oss/rail-audio/main/audio/東海道新幹線_東海道新幹線_7_ja.mp3
text_en: Mishima. Fuji's underground water gushes out from all over the city, giving the city a refreshing feel as a city of water. Being able to see the local atmosphere of Izu-Hakone Railway from the Shinkansen platform is an irresistible attraction for railway fans. If you imagine the footprints of people who walked the ancient Tokaido in the tranquil grounds of Mishima Taisha, your trip will become even more profound.

product_ja:
三島 桜家 うなぎ蒲焼（真空調理）
富士山の雪解け水、三島の「化粧水」にさらされた鰻は、泥臭さが抜け、身が驚くほど清らか。安政年間から続く老舗の味をお取り寄せで。甘さを抑えたキレのあるタレが、ふっくらと蒸し上げられた鰻の脂を引き立てます。口の中でとろけるような食感と、鼻を抜ける炭火の香ばしさ。三島の清流が育んだ、鰻の最高到達点です。
product_en:
Mishima Sakuraya Eel Kabayaki (Vacuum Cooked)
Eels exposed to Mt. Fuji's melting snow water and Mishima's ``lotion'' lose their muddy smell and are surprisingly clean. You can order the taste of a long-established store that has been around since the Ansei era. The sharp sauce with less sweetness brings out the plump fat of the steamed eel. It has a melt-in-your-mouth texture and a charcoal aroma that hits your nose. This is the highest point for eel grown in the clear streams of Mishima.
product_fr:
Anguille Kabayaki Mishima Sakuraya (cuit sous vide)
Les anguilles exposées à l'eau de fonte des neiges du mont Fuji et à la « lotion » de Mishima perdent leur odeur boueuse et sont étonnamment propres. Vous pouvez commander le goût d'un magasin établi de longue date qui existe depuis l'ère Ansei. La sauce piquante, moins sucrée, fait ressortir le gras charnu de l'anguille cuite à la vapeur. Il a une texture fondante et un arôme de charbon qui frappe le nez. C'est le point culminant de l'anguille cultivée dans les cours d'eau clairs de Mishima.
product_tw:
三島櫻屋鰻魚蒲燒（真空烹調）
鰻魚接觸到富士山融化的雪水和三島的「乳液」後，渾濁的氣味消失了，而且出奇地乾淨。可以品嚐從安政時代就已經存在的老店的味道。少了甜度的濃鬱醬汁，襯托出了蒸鰻魚的肥美。它具有入口即化的質感和撲鼻而來的木炭香氣。這裡是三島清澈溪流中生長的鰻魚的最高點。

audio_ja: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saffron12safron-oss/rail-audio/main/audio/東海道新幹線_東海道新幹線_8_ja.mp3
text_en: New Fuji. It goes without saying that the majestic view of Mt. Fuji spreading out from the train window is the main attraction of this station. The smoke rising from the chimneys of paper mills conveys the pride of the region that supported the industrial development of the Showa era. The moment you hear the roar as you cross the Fuji River iron bridge and look up at Japan's tallest mountain is truly the real thrill of traveling by train.

product_ja:
田子の浦 釜揚げしらす
富士の雄大な景色を背に、一艘引き漁法で鮮度抜群のまま水揚げされる田子の浦のしらす。獲れたてをすぐに釜茹でした身は、ふんわりと柔らかく、まるで白い宝石のよう。絶妙な塩加減が、しらす本来の甘みと海の香りを引き出します。たっぷりとご飯に載せ、少しの醤油と大根おろしで。富士の恵みを全身で感じる朝食をどうぞ。
product_en:
Tagonoura kettle-fried whitebait
With the majestic view of Mt. Fuji in the background, the whitebait from Tagonoura is landed at an extremely fresh level using the single-boat fishing method. Freshly caught and immediately boiled in a pot, the meat is soft and fluffy, like a white jewel. The perfect amount of salt brings out the natural sweetness and scent of the sea. Serve generously over rice, with a little soy sauce and grated daikon radish. Enjoy breakfast where you can feel the blessings of Fuji with your entire body.
product_fr:
Poisson blanc frit à la marmite Tagonoura
Avec la vue majestueuse sur le mont Fuji en arrière-plan, le poisson blanc de Tagonoura est débarqué à un niveau extrêmement frais grâce à la méthode de pêche sur un seul bateau. Fraîchement pêchée et aussitôt bouillie dans une marmite, la viande est moelleuse et moelleuse, tel un joyau blanc. La quantité parfaite de sel fait ressortir la douceur et le parfum naturels de la mer. Servir généreusement sur du riz, avec un peu de sauce soja et du radis daikon râpé. Profitez d'un petit-déjeuner où vous pourrez ressentir les bénédictions du Fuji avec tout votre corps.

audio_ja: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saffron12safron-oss/rail-audio/main/audio/東海道新幹線_東海道新幹線_9_ja.mp3
text_en: Shizuoka. The elegance of Suruga Castle and the calm townscape filled with the scent of tea will soothe your mind. This land, chosen by the great Tokugawa Ieyasu as his retirement location, is rich in nature and culture. The time you spend squinting at the green tea fields you see from the train window while stuffing yourself with Abe River Mochi is a luxurious moment.

product_ja:
静岡銘菓 安部川もち（もちや）
徳川家康公が命名したと伝わる、静岡を代表する名物。お取り寄せ可能な「もちや」の安部川もちは、つきたての柔らかさを保つ伝統の製法。香り高いきな粉をたっぷり纏ったお餅と、上品な甘さのこしあんに包まれたお餅の二つの味が楽しめます。静岡の豊かな歴史と、富士の伏流水が育んだ餅の粘りを、ぜひご自宅で。
product_en:
Shizuoka famous confectionery Abe River Mochi (Mochiya)
It is said to have been named by Lord Tokugawa Ieyasu, and is a representative specialty of Shizuoka. Abegawa Mochi from Mochiya is available for order using a traditional manufacturing method that maintains the softness of freshly made mochi. You can enjoy two flavors: the rice cake is coated with plenty of aromatic soybean flour, and the rice cake is wrapped in elegantly sweet strained bean paste. Enjoy Shizuoka's rich history and the sticky mochi made with Fuji's underground water at home.
product_fr:
Célèbre confiserie de Shizuoka Abe River Mochi (Mochiya)
On dit qu'il a été nommé par le Seigneur Tokugawa Ieyasu et qu'il s'agit d'une spécialité représentative de Shizuoka. Abegawa Mochi de Mochiya est disponible à la commande selon une méthode de fabrication traditionnelle qui préserve la douceur du mochi fraîchement préparé. Vous pouvez déguster deux saveurs : le gâteau de riz est enrobé de beaucoup de farine de soja aromatique et le gâteau de riz est enveloppé dans une pâte de haricots filtrée élégamment sucrée. Profitez de la riche histoire de Shizuoka et du mochi gluant fabriqué avec l'eau souterraine de Fuji chez vous.
product_tw:
靜岡名品點心安倍河麻糬（Mochiya）
據說是德川家康所命名的，是靜岡縣的代表特產。 Mochiya 的安倍川麻糬採用傳統製造方法，可保持新鮮麻糬的柔軟度，可供訂購。有兩種口味可供選擇：年糕裹滿了香濃的黃豆粉，年糕包裹著甜甜的豆沙。在家即可享受靜岡悠久的歷史和用富士地下水製作的粘稠麻糬。

audio_ja: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/saffron12safron-oss/rail-audio/main/audio/東海道新幹線_東海道新幹線_10_ja.mp3
text_en: Kakegawa. The warmth of the wooden station building remains, and even though it is a Shinkansen station, it has a somewhat nostalgic scenery. The sight of the reconstructed castle tower of Kakegawa Castle watching over the city makes us strongly aware of the continuity of history. In this area, where traditional crafts such as kudzu cloth and tea are still alive, there is a polite way of life that the Japanese had almost forgotten.

product_ja:
掛川 深蒸し茶（特選茶葉）
通常の倍以上の時間をかけて蒸し上げる「掛川の深蒸し茶」。濃厚な緑色と、角の取れたまろやかな甘みが最大の特徴です。一口飲めば、茶葉の旨味がどっしりと広がり、心まで解きほぐされるよう。茶草場農法という世界遺産級の伝統技術で守られた茶畑の情景が浮かびます。これぞ、お茶どころ静岡の誇り高き一杯です。
product_en:
Kakegawa deep steamed tea (specially selected tea leaves)
``Kakegawa deep steamed tea'' is steamed for more than twice the time as usual. Its biggest characteristics are its rich green color and rounded, mellow sweetness. When you take a sip, the rich flavor of the tea leaves spreads out, and your soul will be relaxed. The scenery comes to mind of a tea plantation that has been preserved using the Chagusaba farming method, a traditional technique that is classified as a World Heritage Site. This is the proud cup of tea from Shizuoka.
product_fr:
Thé Kakegawa cuit à la vapeur (feuilles de thé spécialement sélectionnées)
Le « thé cuit à la vapeur profonde Kakegawa » est cuit à la vapeur plus de deux fois plus longtemps que d'habitude. Ses plus grandes caractéristiques sont sa riche couleur verte et sa douceur ronde et moelleuse. Lorsque vous en prenez une gorgée, la riche saveur des feuilles de thé se répand et votre âme sera détendue. Le paysage évoque une plantation de thé préservée grâce à la méthode agricole Chagusaba, une technique traditionnelle classée au patrimoine mondial. C'est la fière tasse de thé de Shizuoka.
product_tw:
掛川深蒸茶（特選茶葉）
「掛川深蒸茶」的蒸煮時間是平常的兩倍以上。其最大特色是色澤濃綠、甜味圓潤、醇厚。當你喝一口的時候，濃鬱的茶葉香氣就散發出來，你的心靈也會得到放鬆。這裡的風景讓人想起使用Chagusaba耕作方法保存下來的茶園，這是一種被列為世界遺產的傳統技術。這是靜岡引以為傲的茶。

As you approach the vast surface of Lake Hamana, you get the feeling that you have finally arrived at a key point in the Tokai region. When you get off the station in search of the famous eel, the energy of the lively city will soothe your fatigue.

product_ja:
浜松餃子 石松（冷凍セット）
餃子の街・浜松を牽引する名店「石松」。キャベツをたっぷり使った餡は、驚くほど甘く、あっさりとしていながらコクがあります。お取り寄せの冷凍餃子をフライパンで円形に焼き、真ん中に茹でもやしを添えれば、そこはもう浜松。薄皮のパリッとした食感と、溢れ出す野菜の甘みに、箸が止まらなくなること間違いなしです。
product_en:
Hamamatsu Gyoza Ishimatsu (frozen set)
Ishimatsu is a famous restaurant that leads the gyoza town of Hamamatsu. The filling made with plenty of cabbage is surprisingly sweet, light, yet rich. Fry the frozen gyoza you ordered in a circular shape in a frying pan, add boiled bean sprouts in the middle, and you're in Hamamatsu. The crispy texture of the thin skin and the overflowing sweetness of the vegetables will definitely make you unable to stop using your chopsticks.
product_fr:
Hamamatsu Gyoza Ishimatsu (ensemble congelé)
Ishimatsu est un restaurant célèbre qui dirige la ville de gyoza de Hamamatsu. La garniture à base de chou est étonnamment sucrée, légère et riche. Faites frire le gyoza surgelé que vous avez commandé en forme circulaire dans une poêle, ajoutez des germes de soja bouillis au milieu et vous êtes à Hamamatsu. La texture croustillante de la peau fine et la douceur débordante des légumes vous empêcheront définitivement d'utiliser vos baguettes.
product_tw:
濱松餃子石松（冷凍套餐）
石松是濱松餃子街的著名餐廳。用大量捲心菜製成的餡料出乎意料地甜甜、清淡，但味道濃鬱。將點好的冷凍餃子放入平底鍋中煎成圓形，在中間加入煮熟的豆芽，就到了濱鬆了。薄皮的酥脆口感和蔬菜溢出的甜味，絕對讓你停不下筷子。

The area in front of the station, where the history told by the stone walls of Yoshida Castle intersects with the fragrant smell of chikuwa, is filled with a truly human charm. It gives you a sense of the simple and sturdy spirit of this town located on the border of Mikawa and Totomi.

product_ja:
ヤマサちくわ 特選ちくわ
文政十年創業、豊橋の看板を背負うヤマサちくわ。グチやエソといった白身魚のすり身を、職人が炭火で丁寧に焼き上げています。お取り寄せのちくわを噛みしめれば、弾力のある歯ごたえと、魚本来の芳醇な旨味が口に広がります。そのままかじるも良し、少し炙ってわさびを添えるも良し。三河湾の恵みが凝縮された逸品です。
product_en:
Yamasa Chikuwa Special Chikuwa
Yamasa Chikuwa, founded in the 19th year of the Bunsei era, carries the Toyohashi signboard on its back. Our artisans carefully grill the minced white fish such as croaker and eso over charcoal. When you bite into the chikuwa that we have ordered, you will be greeted with a springy texture and the rich flavor of fish that fills your mouth. You can bite into it as is, or grill it a little and add wasabi. This is a masterpiece that condenses the blessings of Mikawa Bay.
product_fr:
Yamasa Chikuwa Spécial Chikuwa
Yamasa Chikuwa, fondée au cours de la 19e année de l'ère Bunsei, porte l'enseigne Toyohashi sur son dos. Nos artisans grillent soigneusement les poissons blancs hachés comme le courbine et l'eso sur du charbon de bois. Lorsque vous mordez dans le chikuwa que nous avons commandé, vous serez accueilli par une texture printanière et la riche saveur du poisson qui remplit votre bouche. Vous pouvez le croquer tel quel, ou le griller un peu et ajouter du wasabi. C'est un chef-d'œuvre qui condense les bienfaits de la baie de Mikawa.
product_tw:
山佐竹輪 特別竹輪
文政19年創立的“山佐竹輪”，背負著豐橋的招牌。我們的工匠在木炭上小心地燒烤黃花魚和 Eso 等白魚碎。當你咬下我們點的竹輪時，充滿彈性的口感和濃鬱的魚味充滿了口腔。你可以直接咬下去，或者稍微烤一下然後加入芥末。這是凝聚三河灣恩惠的傑作。

The neatly arranged surrounding area tells of the history of post-war agrarian reform and development. As you watch the Nozomi train pass by at breakneck speed, you can experience the quiet time that can only be had on a journey that stops at each station.

product_ja:
安城産 いちじくジャム・スイーツセット
「日本のデンマーク」と呼ばれた農業の先進地、安城。全国屈指の生産量を誇るいちじくは、その濃厚な甘みと高貴な香りが特徴です。旬の美味しさを閉じ込めたジャムやコンポートは、お取り寄せでも大人気。果肉のプチプチとした食感と、とろけるような甘みが、トーストやヨーグルトを特別な一皿に変えてくれます。
product_en:
Anjo fig jam and sweets set
Anjo is an advanced agricultural region known as the "Denmark of Japan." Figs, which boast one of the highest production volumes in Japan, are characterized by their rich sweetness and noble aroma. Jams and compotes that contain the deliciousness of the season are very popular even when ordered. The chewy texture and melt-in-your-mouth sweetness of the fruit turn toast or yogurt into a special dish.
product_fr:
Coffret confiture et friandises aux figues Anjo
Anjo est une région agricole avancée connue sous le nom de « Danemark du Japon ». Les figues, dont les volumes de production sont parmi les plus élevés au Japon, se caractérisent par leur riche douceur et leur arôme noble. Les confitures et compotes qui contiennent les délices de saison sont très appréciées même sur commande. La texture moelleuse et la douceur fondante du fruit font du pain grillé ou du yaourt un plat spécial.
product_tw:
安城市無花果果醬和甜點套裝
安城是一個農業發達地區，被譽為「日本的丹麥」。無花果是日本產量最高的無花果之一，其特點是濃鬱的甜味和高貴的香氣。含有當季美味的果醬和蜜餞即使點了也很受歡迎。水果的耐嚼質地和入口即化的甜味使吐司或優格成為一道特別的菜餚。

The hustle and bustle around the station and the diversity of food culture that spreads through the underground mall are truly an extension of the powerful Showa era. Part of the fun of traveling is being drawn in by the scent of miso cutlets and chicken wings, and surrendering to the vibrancy of the great city.

product_ja:
世界の山ちゃん 幻の手羽先（冷凍）
名古屋メシの代表格、刺激的な胡椒の辛さがクセになる「幻の手羽先」。お取り寄せなら、レンジとトースターで揚げるだけで、あの店の味が完全再現。ピリリと効いたスパイスと、秘伝のタレが鶏肉の旨味を引き立て、ビールが無限に進みます。尾張名古屋の活気と、濃い口の文化を象徴する、パンチの効いた逸品です。
product_en:
Yamachan of the World: Phantom Chicken Wings (Frozen)
The ``phantom chicken wings'' are a representative dish of Nagoya food and have an addictive spicy pepper flavor. If you order it, just fry it in the microwave and toaster to perfectly recreate the taste of that restaurant. The spicy spices and secret sauce bring out the flavor of the chicken, and the beer goes on endlessly. This is a masterpiece that packs a punch, symbolizing the vibrancy and rich culture of Owari Nagoya.
product_fr:
Yamachan du monde : ailes de poulet fantômes (congelées)
Les « ailes de poulet fantômes » sont un plat représentatif de la cuisine de Nagoya et ont une saveur de poivre épicé addictive. Si vous le commandez, faites-le simplement frire au micro-ondes et au grille-pain pour recréer parfaitement le goût de ce restaurant. Les épices épicées et la sauce secrète font ressortir la saveur du poulet, et la bière continue sans fin. Il s’agit d’un chef-d’œuvre qui a du punch, symbolisant le dynamisme et la riche culture d’Owari Nagoya.
product_tw:
世界山醬：幻影雞翅（冷凍）
「幻影雞翅」是名古屋美食的代表菜餚，有著讓人上癮的辣椒味。如果您點了它，只需用微波爐和烤麵包機煎一下即可完美再現那家餐廳的味道。辛辣的香料和秘密醬汁襯托出雞肉的鮮味，啤酒也喝不完。這是一部充滿衝擊力的傑作，象徵著尾張名古屋的活力和豐富的文化。

Located in the middle of the vast Nobi Plain, it is a station that has a lot of stories to tell, including its political background, but there is also a certain local life there. In winter, the Ibuki grated snow blows over the area, and the snow-covered streets evoke a sense of travel. When you touch the smiling face of Enku Buddha, you feel the eternal flow of time in this land.

product_ja:
飛騨牛 A5等級 ステーキ用
岐阜が世界に誇るブランド牛、飛騨牛。きめ細やかな霜降りと、口の中でとろけるような柔らかな質感が特徴です。焼けばナッツのような甘い香りが立ち込め、一口噛むごとに上質な脂の旨味が溢れ出します。羽島の清らかな水と、飛騨の山々が育んだ結晶。特別な日を彩る、最高級の肉体験をお約束します。
product_en:
Hida beef grade A5 for steak
Hida beef is Gifu's world-famous brand of beef. It is characterized by fine marbling and a soft texture that melts in your mouth. When grilled, it emits a sweet, nutty aroma, and the flavor of the high-quality fat overflows with every bite. Crystals grown in the clear water of Hashima and the mountains of Hida. We promise you the finest meat experience to brighten up your special day.
product_fr:
Bœuf Hida grade A5 pour steak
Le bœuf Hida est la marque de bœuf de Gifu de renommée mondiale. Il se caractérise par un persillage fin et une texture moelleuse qui fond en bouche. Lorsqu'il est grillé, il dégage un arôme sucré de noisette et la saveur de la graisse de haute qualité déborde à chaque bouchée. Cristaux cultivés dans les eaux claires de Hashima et des montagnes de Hida. Nous vous promettons la meilleure expérience de viande pour égayer votre journée spéciale.
product_tw:
A5級飛驒牛牛排
飛驒牛是岐阜縣的世界知名品牌牛肉。它的特點是精細的大理石花紋和入口即化的柔軟質地。燒烤時散發出甜美的堅果香氣，每一口都溢出優質脂肪的味道。羽島清澈的海水和飛驒山脈中生長的水晶。我們承諾為您提供最佳的肉類體驗，讓您的特殊日子更加美好。

Ibuki from the window as the train skims along the east shore of Lake Biwa shows us the beauty of the Omi Road. product_ja:
近江牛の味噌漬け（徳志満）
日本三代和牛の一つ、近江牛を伝統の味噌で漬け込んだ歴史ある逸品。味噌の酵素が肉質をさらに柔らかくし、熟成された旨味を引き出します。フライパンで軽く焼けば、味噌の香ばしい香りが食欲を激しく刺激。とろけるような脂と、味噌の深いコクが合わさったその味わいは、まさに白いご飯の最強のパートナーです。
product_en:
Omi beef marinated in miso (Tokushiman)
A historical masterpiece made with Omi beef, one of Japan's three generations of Wagyu beef, marinated in traditional miso. The enzymes in miso make the meat even softer and bring out the mature flavor. If you fry it lightly in a frying pan, the fragrant aroma of miso will stimulate your appetite. The combination of melting fat and deep richness of miso makes it the perfect partner for white rice.
product_fr:
Bœuf Omi mariné au miso (Tokushiman)
Un chef-d'œuvre historique à base de bœuf Omi, l'une des trois générations de bœuf Wagyu du Japon, mariné dans du miso traditionnel. Les enzymes du miso rendent la viande encore plus douce et font ressortir sa saveur mûre. Si vous le faites frire légèrement dans une poêle, l'arôme parfumé du miso stimulera votre appétit. L’association du gras fondant et de la richesse profonde du miso en fait le partenaire idéal du riz blanc.
product_tw:
近江牛肉味噌醃製（德志萬）
採用日本三代和牛之一的近江牛，以傳統味噌醃製而成的歷史傑作。味噌中的酵素使肉變得更加柔軟，並帶出成熟的味道。如果用平底鍋輕輕煎一下，味噌的芳香就會讓人食慾大開。融化的脂肪和味噌的濃鬱口感相結合，使其成為白米飯的完美搭檔。

The tranquility of the old temples and shrines is in perfect harmony with the modern architecture of the station building. The flow of the Kamogawa River, the Okuribi of the Five Mountains, and the changing appearance of this city depending on the season offer us new discoveries no matter how many times we visit.

product_ja:
伊藤久右衛門 宇治抹茶スイーツ詰め合わせ
古都・京都の雅を形にした、石臼挽き宇治抹茶のスイーツ。お取り寄せで人気の詰め合わせは、抹茶の深い苦みと香りを生かした生チョコやロールケーキが揃います。一口食べれば、そこは宇治の茶畑。濃厚でありながら、後味はどこまでも気品高く爽やか。千年の都が育んできた美意識を、五感で味わう至福のひとときです。
product_en:
Ito Kyuemon Uji matcha sweets assortment
Sweets made from stone-ground Uji matcha green tea, inspired by the elegance of the ancient capital of Kyoto. Our popular assortment includes raw chocolate and roll cakes that bring out the deep bitterness and aroma of matcha. One bite and you'll be transported to a Uji tea plantation. Although it is rich, the aftertaste is elegant and refreshing. It is a blissful moment where you can enjoy with all five senses the sense of beauty that has been cultivated in this thousand-year-old capital.
product_fr:
Assortiment de bonbons matcha Ito Kyuemon Uji
Des douceurs à base de thé vert matcha Uji moulu sur pierre, inspirées de l'élégance de l'ancienne capitale de Kyoto. Notre assortiment populaire comprend du chocolat cru et des petits gâteaux qui font ressortir l'amertume et l'arôme profonds du matcha. Une bouchée et vous serez transporté dans une plantation de thé Uji. Bien qu’il soit riche, l’arrière-goût est élégant et rafraîchissant. C'est un moment de bonheur où vous pourrez profiter avec vos cinq sens du sens de la beauté cultivé dans cette capitale millénaire.
product_tw:
伊藤久右衛門宇治抹茶甜點拼盤
以石磨宇治抹茶綠茶製成的甜點，靈感源自古都京都的優雅。我們受歡迎的品種包括生巧克力和蛋糕卷，可帶出抹茶的濃鬱苦味和香氣。咬一口，就會被帶到宇治茶園。雖濃鬱，但回味淡雅、清爽。這是一個幸福的時刻，您可以用五種感官享受這座千年古都孕育的美感。

The spread of the railway that continues from here to Sanyoji gives us a sense of pride as a key point in the western part of Japan. Beyond the steam from the takoyaki, you can see the vitality of Osaka that has existed since the Showa era, giving you a sense of elation that is a perfect way to end your trip.

551蓬莱 豚まんセット（チルド）
東海道の終着点、大阪。この「豚まん」を抜きに大阪は語れません。甘みのあるもちもちの皮の中に、粗切りされた豚肉と玉ねぎがぎっしり。お取り寄せのチルド品を蒸し上げれば、溢れ出すジューシーな肉汁と、どこか懐かしい香りが部屋を満たします。食い倒れの街・大阪の底力を感じる、ボリューム満点の幸福をどうぞ！
product_en:
551 Horai Butaman set (chilled)
Osaka, the final destination of the Tokaido. You can't talk about Osaka without mentioning this pork bun. The sweet and chewy skin is filled with coarsely chopped pork and onions. When you steam the chilled products you ordered, the juicy meat juices will overflow and the room will be filled with a nostalgic aroma. Enjoy a hearty meal that shows you the true power of Osaka, the city of foodies!
product_fr:
551 Ensemble Horai Butaman (réfrigéré)
Osaka, la destination finale du Tokaido. Vous ne pouvez pas parler d'Osaka sans évoquer ce petit pain au porc. La peau douce et moelleuse est remplie de porc et d'oignons grossièrement hachés. Lorsque vous cuisez à la vapeur les produits réfrigérés que vous avez commandés, les jus de viande juteux débordent et la pièce se remplit d'un arôme nostalgique. Savourez un repas copieux qui vous montre le véritable pouvoir d'Osaka, la ville des gourmets !
product_tw:
551 蓬萊豬滿套裝（冷藏）
大阪，東海道的最終目的地。說到大阪就不能不提到豬肉包。香甜耐嚼的外皮充滿了切碎的豬肉和洋蔥。當你將點的冰鮮產品蒸熟時，多汁的肉汁就會溢出，房間裡就會充滿懷舊的香氣。盡情享受美食之都大阪的魅力吧！

text_en: "Look to your right. Tokyo Tower, the symbol of Tokyo, appears for a moment between the buildings. It is a view that heralds the beginning of your journey."
``Cross the Tama River, the border between Tokyo and Kanagawa Prefecture.The wide riverbed and sky will give you a moment to forget the hustle and bustle of the city.''
``Just before Shin-Yokohama Station, you will see a huge cylindrical building on your right.It is a sacred place for entertainment that has left many impressions.''
``The blue Sagami Bay spreads out on your left.It's only for a moment, but the glow of the sea that can be seen between the tunnels increases your expectations for the trip.''
``To your left, you can see Odawara Castle, a chalk castle tower, in the distance.This is the moment when you can feel the breath of history as the Hojo clan's once impregnable base.''

"Everyone, please pay attention to the area to your right. This is the section where you can see Japan's highest mountain, Mt. Fuji, the most beautiful. Please capture its majestic figure in your eyes."
"A group of chimneys lined up with Mt. Fuji in the background. It is a mysterious combination of the strength that supports Fuji City's industry and the beauty of nature."
"You'll cross the Fuji River, one of Japan's three major rapids. It's one of the most scenic spots on the Shinkansen, where you can enjoy an unobstructed panoramic view of Mt. Fuji."
``Look to your left. The mountains and the sea are approaching, and the road is tied into a difficult area for transportation. A panoramic view of Suruga Bay spreads out in front of you.''
``The shadow of a mountain in the distance on the left is Mt. Kuno, the sacred place where Tokugawa Ieyasu was first buried.The weight of history seems to be carried on the wind.''
"A carpet of green as far as the eye can see. The beautiful scenery of the tea plantations in Shizuoka, Japan's best tea producing area, will soothe your mind."
name_fr: Plantation de thé sur le plateau de Makinohara

text_en: "It's an exhilarating feeling as if you're running on a lake. Please enjoy Lake Hamana, which shows the rich expressions that only a brackish water lake can offer."
"Can you see the red torii gate standing in the lake on your left? It is the symbol of Lake Hamana, a spectacular view at zero meters above sea level."
"For a moment, the tram tracks intersect on the ground in the lower left. It's a meeting between the Shinkansen and the tram, where you can feel the breath of the city of Toyohashi."

name_ja: 日本のデンマーク（安城）
text_en: ``The land of Anjo was once famous as an advanced agricultural area.The rich memories of a farming village that was called the Denmark of Japan continue to this day.''
``JR Central Towers soars high into the sky.A gigantic fortress that supports the economy of the Chubu region welcomes travelers with an overwhelming force.''
name_fr: Groupe de bâtiments de la gare de Nagoya

text_en: ``What you can see on your right is Kiyosu Castle, which is associated with Lord Nobunaga.The contrast between the red Otebashi Bridge and the castle tower evokes the romance of the Sengoku period.''
"A gigantic ark suddenly appears on your right. With a total length of 315 meters, it adds color to the scenery along the railway line as a symbol of solar power generation."

``Sekigahara is the dividing point of the world.In winter, the scenery changes to resemble a snowy country, and it is a place where you can feel the harshness of the terrain and the weight of history.''
``Rising to the right is the famous mountain, Mt. Ibuki. Its majestic appearance is a guidepost that tells you that you have entered Omi Province.''
``You can see Hikone Castle, a national treasure, in the distance on your right.The castle tower is small but dignified.Welcome to the town of Hikonyan.''
``The peaceful Omi Plains has a hint of Lake Biwa.The color of the sky reflected in the rice fields makes you realize that you have entered the Kinki region.''
``We will cross the Seta River, the only river that flows out of Lake Biwa.The ancient strategic point ``Seda no Karahashi Bridge'' is also nearby.''
``Look to your left. The five-storied pagoda of To-ji Temple, the symbol of Kyoto. It's a view that makes everyone realize that they've come to Kyoto.''

name_ja: サントリー山崎蒸溜所
text_en: "At the foot of the mountain on the right is the Yamazaki Distillery, the holy land of Japanese whisky. Why not think about the supreme drop that the famous water produces?"

name_ja: 明治チョコレート看板
text_en: "The world's largest chocolate sign will appear on your right! It's so big that you can almost smell the sweet scent."
"The Shinkansen base stretches out on the left. The rows of white train cars are a spectacular sight, reminiscent of a galactic fleet."
``Cross the Yodo River, the mother river of Osaka.Once you pass here, the final destination (or stopover), Shin-Osaka Station, is just a stone's throw away.''
``The mysterious ``727'' signboard along the Shinkansen line. This number appears everywhere, and you can't help but want to look for it.''
"Right after leaving Shizuoka Station, you'll cross the river that is the origin of the famous Abe River Mochi. Please take a look while remembering this historic confectionery."
"The Tenryu River is a raging river in Enshu. As you cross that vast river, you will feel that you are approaching the city of Hamamatsu."

name_ja: ヤマハ ピアノ工場
text_en: "It's unique to Hamamatsu, the city of musical instruments. You can see the Yamaha signboard on your right. World-class musical instruments are born here."
“Take a close look at the mountain on your right! There is a huge character for ``tea'' made by planting trees. It is a view that makes you feel the pride of Shizuoka.''

Niigata. This town, located at the mouth of the Shinano River, was once a port of call for the Kitamaebune ships, and since the opening of the railway, it has prospered as a key location on the Sea of ​​Japan. Even in modern times, when the Joetsu Shinkansen has been extended from Nagaoka and the stations have become elevated, you can still smell the faint scent of the sea breeze as you step onto the platform. As you picture in your mind the image of the stately station building of the past, you can savor the beginning of your journey.
product_ja:
新潟名物 タレかつ丼のたれ（バスカンなど）
新潟市のソウルフード「タレかつ丼」。揚げたての薄切りカツを、醤油ベースの甘辛い秘伝タレにサッと潜らせる。その瞬間に立ち昇る、香ばしくも甘い香りは、新潟っ子の郷愁を激しく揺さぶります。お取り寄せのタレがあれば、自宅の食卓が一瞬にして新潟の老舗食堂に。熱々のご飯に染みたタレとカツのハーモニーは、まさに魔性の味わいです。
product_en:
Niigata specialty Sauce for katsudon (baskan, etc.)
Niigata City's soul food "Tare Katsudon". Freshly fried, thinly sliced ​​cutlets are quickly submerged in a secret sweet and salty soy sauce-based sauce. The fragrant yet sweet scent that rises at that moment deeply shakes the nostalgia of Niigata residents. If you have the sauce you ordered, your dining table at home will instantly turn into a long-established restaurant in Niigata. The harmony between the sauce soaked in the piping hot rice and the cutlet is truly magical.
product_fr:
Spécialité Niigata Sauce pour katsudon (baskan, etc.)
La nourriture soul de la ville de Niigata "Tare Katsudon". Les côtelettes fraîchement frites et tranchées finement sont rapidement immergées dans une sauce secrète à base de sauce soja sucrée et salée. Le parfum à la fois parfumé et sucré qui s'élève à ce moment-là ébranle profondément la nostalgie des habitants de Niigata. Si vous avez la sauce que vous avez commandée, votre table à manger à la maison se transformera instantanément en un restaurant établi de longue date à Niigata. L'harmonie entre la sauce trempée dans le riz bien chaud et l'escalope est vraiment magique.
product_tw:
新潟特產炸豬排丼（巴斯幹等）醬汁
新潟市的靈魂美食「Tare Katsudon」。新鮮油炸的薄片肉片很快就浸入秘製甜鹹醬油中。那一刻升起的芬芳而甜美的香氣，深深震撼了新潟居民的鄉愁。如果你點了醬汁，家裡的餐桌立刻就變成了新潟的老字號餐廳。熱騰騰的米飯中浸泡的醬汁與炸肉排的和諧真是神奇。

text_en: Higashi Niigata. This area, which is home to a vast train yard, has supported Japanese industry as the heart of freight transportation. A bunch of train tracks lined up in an orderly manner and the occasional metallic sound of a coupler. The sight of rugged electric locomotives resting quietly conveys the power of railways from the days when steam locomotives emitted soot.

Large size. Houses are lined up around the station, and you can feel the history of how the once idyllic rural landscape gradually changed into a cityscape. The fact that it once started as a signal station and was eventually promoted to a passenger station is proof that it has evolved along with the development of the area along the line. In the scenery flowing outside the window, we find the warmth of the close connection between daily life and railways.
product_ja:
栗山米菓「ばかうけ」新潟限定セット
実は「ばかうけ」の生みの親、栗山米菓の本社は大形駅のすぐ近くにあります。米どころ新潟が誇るせんべい技術の結晶です。お取り寄せでは、県内限定の「タレかつ味」や「南蛮えび味」を詰め合わせたセットが人気。パリッとした軽快な食感の後に、地元の旨味が口いっぱいに広がります。新潟の空気を運んでくれる、大人も子供も笑顔にする魔法のお菓子です。
product_en:
Kuriyama Beika “Bakauke” Niigata limited set
In fact, the headquarters of Kuriyama Beika, the creator of Bakauke, is located right near Ogata Station. This is the culmination of rice cracker technology that Niigata, the rice producing region, is proud of. For ordering, popular sets include ``Tare Katsu Flavor'' and ``Nanban Shrimp Flavor,'' which are limited to the prefecture. After a light and crispy texture, the local flavor will fill your mouth. These magical sweets bring smiles to both adults and children, bringing the atmosphere of Niigata.
product_fr:
Kuriyama Beika « Bakauke » Niigata ensemble limité
En fait, le siège de Kuriyama Beika, le créateur du Bakauke, est situé juste à côté de la gare d'Ogata. Il s’agit du point culminant de la technologie des crackers de riz dont Niigata, la région productrice de riz, est fière. Pour commander, les ensembles populaires incluent « Tare Katsu Flavor » et « Nanban Shrimp Flavor », qui sont limités à la préfecture. Après une texture légère et croustillante, la saveur locale vous remplira la bouche. Ces bonbons magiques font sourire les adultes et les enfants, apportant l'atmosphère de Niigata.
product_tw:
栗山貝華「Bakauke」新潟限定套裝
事實上，Bakauke 的創造者栗山倍華的總部就位於緒方站附近。這是稻米產地新潟引以自豪的米果技術的巔峰之作。點餐時，人氣套餐有縣內限定的「炸豬排口味」和「南蠻蝦口味」。口感輕薄酥脆後，當地風味充滿口腔。這些神奇的甜點帶給大人和小孩微笑，帶來新潟的氣氛。

text_en: Shinsaki. This station, located just before crossing the Agano River, retains memories of the industry where the dedicated line to the fertilizer factory once branched off. The bustling freight transportation industry of the past appears like a ghost in the spacious premises. The appearance of this station gives travelers peace of mind as if they are taking a breather while listening to the roar of the iron bridge crossing the river.
product_ja:
越後名産 しょうゆの実（郷土発酵食品）
[紹介文]
阿賀野川のほとり、新崎周辺で古くから愛されてきた「食べる醤油」。大麦や大豆を麹で発酵させ、醤油に漬け込んだこの逸品は、噛むほどに大豆の甘みと発酵の深いコクが弾けます。炊きたてのご飯に載せるのはもちろん、冷奴やキュウリに添えれば、日本酒が止まらなくなる最高のアテに。越後の農家の知恵が詰まった、滋味豊かな発酵の宝物です。
product_en:
Echigo specialty soy sauce berries (local fermented food)
[Introduction]
"Eatable soy sauce" has been loved for a long time in the Shinsaki area on the banks of the Agano River. This masterpiece is made by fermenting barley and soybeans with koji and marinating them in soy sauce, and the more you bite into it, the sweetness of the soybeans and the deep richness of the fermentation burst out. Of course you can put it on freshly cooked rice, but you can also add it to cold tofu or cucumbers for a perfect accompaniment that will make you want to drink sake. A nutritious fermented treasure filled with the wisdom of Echigo farmers.
product_fr:
Baies de sauce soja spécialité Echigo (aliment fermenté local)
[Présentation]
La « sauce soja comestible » est appréciée depuis longtemps dans la région de Shinsaki, sur les rives de la rivière Agano. Ce chef-d'œuvre est obtenu en faisant fermenter de l'orge et des graines de soja avec du koji et en les faisant mariner dans de la sauce soja, et plus vous y mordez, plus la douceur des graines de soja et la profonde richesse de la fermentation éclatent. Vous pouvez bien sûr le mettre sur du riz fraîchement cuit, mais vous pouvez également l'ajouter à du tofu froid ou des concombres pour un accompagnement parfait qui vous donnera envie de boire du saké. Un trésor fermenté nutritif rempli de la sagesse des agriculteurs d'Echigo.
product_tw:
越後特產醬油莓（當地發酵食品）
[簡介]
「可以吃的醬油」在阿賀野川河畔的新崎地區自古以來就深受人們的喜愛。這道傑作是將大麥和大豆用曲發酵，然後用醬油醃製而成，越咬下去，大豆的甜味和發酵的深層濃鬱感就會爆發出來。當然，你可以將它放在剛煮熟的米飯上，但你也可以將它添加到冷豆腐或黃瓜中，這是一個完美的搭配，讓你想喝清酒。充滿越後農民智慧的營養豐富的發酵寶藏。

text_en: Early commuter. This area, which was once a vast lagoon, has a history of being transformed into a rich, beautiful rice field through the blood-curing efforts of our predecessors. The expanse of the plains seen from the station platform is a testament to the richness of the Echigo plains. In the Showa era, women peddlers can be seen boarding trains from this station, carrying heavy burdens on their backs.

Toyosaka. As the name of the place, Katsuzuka, suggests, it was a bustling center where a market was held since ancient times. The entrance to the town, which embraces the nature of Fukushima Lagoon and became a city after a merger in the Showa era, exudes a somewhat proud atmosphere. When you get off the train in front of the station, you can almost hear the vibrancy of the area as a distribution center for lumber and agricultural products on the wind.
product_ja:
十一屋商店 茄子のからし漬
豊栄は、新潟が誇る「茄子王国」。ここで収穫された小粒で身の締まった茄子を、ツーンと鼻を抜ける和辛子で漬け込んだ一品は、食卓に欠かせない名脇役です。一口噛めば、茄子の瑞々しい甘みと、強烈な辛みが交差し、思わずご飯をかき込みたくなること請け合い。夏の暑さを吹き飛ばすような、越後平野の力強さを感じる伝統の味です。
product_en:
Juichiya Shoten Eggplant Pickled in Mustard
Toyosaka is the ``Eggplant Kingdom'' that Niigata is proud of. The small, firm eggplants harvested here are marinated in spicy Japanese mustard, making this dish an indispensable addition to your dining table. When you take a bite, the fresh sweetness of the eggplant intersects with the strong spiciness, and you're guaranteed to want to stir it in with your rice. It's a traditional flavor that lets you feel the strength of the Echigo plains, blowing away the summer heat.
product_fr:
Aubergines Juichiya Shoten marinées à la moutarde
Toyosaka est le « Royaume de l'Aubergine » dont Niigata est fier. Les petites aubergines fermes récoltées ici sont marinées dans de la moutarde japonaise épicée, faisant de ce plat un ajout indispensable à votre table à manger. Lorsque vous prenez une bouchée, la douceur fraîche de l'aubergine se croise avec le fort piquant, et vous êtes assuré de vouloir l'incorporer à votre riz. C'est une saveur traditionnelle qui vous permet de ressentir la force des plaines d'Echigo, chassant la chaleur estivale.
product_tw:
十一屋商店芥末茄子
豐坂是新潟引以為傲的「茄子王國」。這裡收穫的小而緊實的茄子，用辛辣的日本芥末醃製，使這道菜成為您餐桌上不可或缺的一道菜。咬一口，茄子的鮮甜與濃鬱的辣味交相輝映，讓人忍不住想要將它拌入米飯中。這是一種傳統風味，可以讓您感受到越後平原的力量，驅散夏天的炎熱。

text_en: Kuroyama. From here, the dedicated line that leads to Niigata Port separates, and you can sometimes see Shiki-cars carrying heavy objects such as giant transformers, making it a well-known area for railway fans. Despite its quiet, unmanned appearance, it serves as a logistics hub that supports Japan's heavy industry behind the scenes. It is this gap that reveals the depth of the railway system.

Sasaki. The area along the railroad tracks, which draw a large curve, has long been loved as a sacred place for those who aspire to train photography. The sight of the limited express train ``Inaho'' running through the golden ears of rice is truly an original Japanese landscape. This village is dotted with the mansions of former landowners, and the weight of its ancient history is quietly piling up there.
product_ja:
越後新発田産 砂丘メロン（旬の時期限定・加工品）
日本海沿いに広がる砂丘地帯。水はけが良く、日照時間の長いこの土地で育つ「砂丘メロン」は、驚くほどの糖度とキメ細やかな果肉が自慢です。お取り寄せでは、その芳醇な香りを閉じ込めたゼリーや、旬の時期の産地直送ギフトが絶大な人気。口の中でとろける甘さは、潮風と太陽が育んだ自然の贈り物。佐々木の穏やかな田園風景を思い浮かべながらどうぞ。
product_en:
Sand dune melon from Echigo Shibata (seasonal limited/processed product)
A sand dune area that stretches along the Sea of Japan. Sand Dune Melon, which grows in this land with good drainage and long sunshine hours, is proud of its amazing sugar content and fine-textured flesh. When ordering, jelly with its rich aroma is extremely popular, as well as gifts delivered directly from the farm during the seasonal season. The sweetness that melts in your mouth is a gift of nature nurtured by the sea breeze and sun. Please enjoy it while imagining the peaceful rural scenery of Sasaki.
product_fr:
Melon des dunes de sable d'Echigo Shibata (produit saisonnier limité/transformé)
Une zone de dunes de sable qui s'étend le long de la mer du Japon. Le melon des dunes de sable, qui pousse sur ces terres bien drainées et avec de longues heures d'ensoleillement, est fier de son incroyable teneur en sucre et de sa chair à texture fine. Lors de la commande, la gelée aux arômes riches est extrêmement appréciée, ainsi que les cadeaux livrés directement de la ferme pendant la saison saisonnière. La douceur qui fond dans la bouche est un cadeau de la nature nourri par la brise marine et le soleil. Profitez-en tout en imaginant le paisible paysage rural de Sasaki.
product_tw:
越後柴田沙丘甜瓜（季節性限定/加工品）
沿著日本海延伸的沙丘地區。生長在這片排水良好、日照時間長的土地上的沙丘瓜，以其驚人的含糖量和細膩的果肉而自豪。點餐時，香氣濃鬱的果凍以及當季農場直送的禮物都非常受歡迎。入口即化的甜味是海風和陽光孕育的大自然的禮物。請一邊想著佐佐木寧靜的田園風光一邊欣賞。

text_en: West Shibata. In recent years, large commercial facilities have sprung up here and the area has been given a new look, but it was once a quiet stop surrounded by rice fields. The change in the center of gravity of the city through station relocation and redevelopment clearly reflects the changes in regional cities. The convenience is combined with the sounds of old railroad crossings and the scenery of the ridges, making us think about the flow of the times.

Shibata. This station still retains the majesty of a former castle town, and its white-walled barracks and old townscape will soothe the soul of travelers. As a junction where the Uetsu Main Line and the Hakushin Line intersect, it has the weight of a history that has seen off many travelers. The smell of ekiben on the platform and the silence of waiting for the train to depart give you a strong sense of the lingering scent of the Showa era.
product_ja:
菊水酒造 ふなぐち一番しぼり（缶・ギフトセット）
白新線の終着、城下町・新発田。ここで生まれた「ふなぐち菊水」は、日本初の生原酒缶として全国の愛酒家を唸らせました。一切の加水や加熱をしない、生まれたままの酒。フレッシュでフルーティーな香りと、どっしりとしたコク、そして19度という力強いアルコール感が、心まで酔わせてくれます。新発田の冬の厳しさと、蔵人の情熱が弾ける、越後を代表する名酒です。
product_en:
Kikusui Sake Brewery Funaguchi Ichiban Shibori (can/gift set)
Shibata, the castle town, is the last stop on the Hakushin Line. ``Funaguchi Kikusui'', which was born here, was Japan's first canned unprocessed sake and wowed sake lovers across the country. Sake is made as it is without adding any water or heating. The fresh, fruity aroma, rich body, and powerful alcoholic feel of 19% will intoxicate you to the core. This is a famous sake representing Echigo that captures the harshness of Shibata's winter and the passion of the brewer.
product_fr:
Kikusui Sake Brewery Funaguchi Ichiban Shibori (canette/coffret cadeau)
Shibata, la ville-château, est le dernier arrêt de la ligne Hakushin. Le « Funaguchi Kikusui », né ici, fut le premier saké non transformé en conserve du Japon et a séduit les amateurs de saké de tout le pays. Le saké est fabriqué tel quel sans ajout d’eau ni chauffage. L'arôme frais et fruité, le corps riche et la puissante sensation alcoolique de 19 % vous enivreront jusqu'au plus profond. Il s'agit d'un célèbre saké représentant Echigo qui capture la rigueur de l'hiver de Shibata et la passion du brasseur.
product_tw:
菊水酒造船口一番絞（罐/禮品組）
城下町柴田是白神線的終點站。這裡誕生的「船口菊水」是日本第一批罐裝未加工清酒，令全國清酒愛好者驚嘆不已。清酒是按原樣釀造的，不加任何水或加熱。清新的果香，濃鬱的酒體，以及19度的強勁酒精感，讓您沉醉其中。這是越後代表的著名清酒，充分體現了柴田嚴冬的嚴酷和釀酒師的熱情。

text_en: Myoko plateau. It was once called Taguchi Station and was famous as the gateway to the magnificent mountain, Mt. Myoko. During its heyday in the Showa era, the platform would be filled with lively skiers dressed in colorful clothing after getting off night trains such as the Spur. Currently, it serves as a border station connecting Nagano and Niigata, and a connection point with the Shinano Railway, but as soon as you get off the station, you can still see the majestic mountain view that looms in front of you and the clear, high-altitude air that still makes you feel the change of the four seasons.

product_ja:
妙高高原ビール（ピルスナー・ヴァイツェン・ダーク）
妙高山の麓、冷涼な高原の空気と清冽な天然水が育んだクラフトビール。ヨーロッパの伝統的な製法にこだわり、麦芽100％で丁寧に仕込まれた一杯は、驚くほどクリアで芳醇な香りが特徴です。雪解け水のように喉を潤し、後に残る上品なホップの苦味。妙高の森を吹き抜ける風を感じながら、至福の乾杯をどうぞ。
product_en:
Myoko Kogen Beer (Pilsner Weizen Dark)
Craft beer grown in the cool highland air and clear natural water at the foot of Mt. Myoko. Using traditional European manufacturing methods, each cup is carefully brewed with 100% malt and has a surprisingly clear and mellow aroma. It quenches your throat like water from melting snow, and leaves behind an elegant hop bitterness. Enjoy a blissful toast while feeling the wind blowing through the Myoko forest.
product_fr:
Bière Myoko Kogen (Pilsner Weizen Dark)
Bière artisanale cultivée dans l'air frais des hautes terres et dans l'eau naturelle claire au pied du mont Myoko. Utilisant des méthodes de fabrication européennes traditionnelles, chaque tasse est soigneusement brassée avec 100 % de malt et dégage un arôme étonnamment clair et doux. Il désaltère la gorge comme l'eau d'une neige fondante et laisse derrière lui une élégante amertume de houblon. Savourez un délicieux toast tout en sentant le vent souffler dans la forêt de Myoko.
product_tw:
妙高高原啤酒（比爾森黑啤酒）
在妙高山腳下涼爽的高原空氣和清澈的天然水中種植的精釀啤酒。採用歐洲傳統製造方法，每杯均採用100%麥芽精心釀造，具有令人驚訝的清澈醇厚香氣。它像融雪中的水一樣滋潤你的喉嚨，並留下優雅的啤酒花苦味。一邊感受妙高森林吹過的風，一邊享受幸福的祝酒。

text_en: Sekishan. In ancient times, the town prospered as a temple town to Sekiyama Shrine, and still retains its solemn atmosphere as a base for the path of Shugen Shugen. In order to overcome this steep gradient, spectacular switchbacks were once installed, and it is still talked about among fans today as a valuable piece of railway history. The ``Kari Yamabushi Dance'', a heroic fire festival held every summer, revitalizes the village, and even on winter days when the area is covered in snow, you can feel the strength of the people who survive together with the mountains and the preciousness of their traditions.

product_ja:
妙高名産「かんずり」
真っ白な雪の上に真っ赤な唐辛子を撒く「雪さらし」は、妙高の冬の風物詩。雪が雑味を抜き、米麹と柚子、塩とともに3年も熟成させることで、ただ辛いだけではない、深みのある旨味と爽やかな香りが生まれます。鍋物や刺身の薬味に、一舐めすれば体の芯からポカポカと温まる、雪国の知恵が詰まった「魔法の調味料」です。
product_en:
Myoko specialty “Kanzuri”
``Yukisarashi'', which involves scattering bright red chili peppers on pure white snow, is a winter tradition in Myoko. The snow removes the unpleasant flavors, and by aging it for three years with rice malt, yuzu, and salt, it creates a deep flavor and refreshing aroma that is not just spicy. It is a ``magical seasoning'' filled with the wisdom of the snowy country that will warm you from the core with just one sip, making it a condiment for hot pot dishes and sashimi.
product_fr:
Spécialité Myoko « Kanzuri »
Le « Yukisarashi », qui consiste à disperser des piments rouges vifs sur de la neige d'un blanc pur, est une tradition hivernale à Myoko. La neige élimine les saveurs désagréables et en la faisant vieillir pendant trois ans avec du malt de riz, du yuzu et du sel, elle crée une saveur profonde et un arôme rafraîchissant qui n'est pas seulement épicé. C'est un « assaisonnement magique » rempli de la sagesse du pays enneigé qui vous réchauffera du cœur avec une seule gorgée, ce qui en fait un condiment pour les plats chauds et les sashimis.

text_en: Nihongi. It is a ``treasure trove of railway heritage'' with working switchbacks, which are rare even in Japan, still in operation and welcoming travelers. The sight of the brick water absorption tower, underground passageway, and wooden snow fences that protect the railway tracks from the snow gives it the feel of a living museum. The delicate movement of the train as it carefully slides onto the platform after making complicated turns gives us a sense of the wisdom and deep love for railways of our predecessors who supported Japan's modernization.

product_ja:
君の井酒造「山廃純米（やまはいじゅんまい）」
日本でも珍しいスイッチバックの駅のそばに構える、江戸時代創業の老舗蔵。伝統の「山廃仕込み」により、空気中の乳酸菌を取り込みじっくり醸された酒は、力強い旨味と酸味が調和した「濃醇」な味わい。ぬる燗にすれば、雪深い二本木の情景が浮かぶような優しい温もりが広がります。これぞ、本物の地酒の風格。
product_en:
Kiminoi Sake Brewery “Yamahai Junmai”
A long-established brewery founded in the Edo period, located near a switchback station, which is rare even in Japan. The sake is carefully brewed using the traditional ``Yamahai Shikomi'' method, which incorporates lactic acid bacteria from the air, and has a ``rich'' flavor that harmonizes strong umami and sourness. When served lukewarm, it gives off a gentle warmth that brings to mind the snowy landscape of Nihongi. This is the style of authentic local sake.
product_fr:
Brasserie de saké Kiminoi « Yamahai Junmai »
Une brasserie historique fondée à l'époque d'Edo, située à proximité d'une gare en lacets, ce qui est rare même au Japon. Le saké est soigneusement brassé selon la méthode traditionnelle « Yamahai Shikomi », qui incorpore des bactéries lactiques présentes dans l'air, et a une saveur « riche » qui harmonise une forte umami et une acidité. Servi tiède, il dégage une douce chaleur qui rappelle le paysage enneigé de Nihongi. C'est le style du saké local authentique.
product_tw:
君之井清酒釀造所“山井純米”
江戶時代創立的老字號啤酒廠，位於日本也很少見的之字形車站附近。這款清酒採用傳統的「山海四味」方法精心釀造，其中融入了空氣中的乳酸菌，具有將濃鬱的鮮味和酸味融為一體的「濃鬱」風味。溫熱時，會散發出柔和的溫暖，讓人聯想到日本的雪景。這就是正宗的當地清酒的風格。

text_en: Arai. Located in the center of Myoko City, it is a transportation and industrial hub for the Kubiki region, where limited express trains and express trains once stopped. In winter, the sight of making ``Kanzuri'', in which bright red chili peppers are exposed in the snow to bring out the spiciness, is a sight that is unique to this region and is a sight to behold. The station building has been given a modern look, but when you step off the platform and look up at the majestic ridgeline of the Kubiki Sanzan, you can still feel the same sense of peace and rich lyricism of travel.
